ko.title: 주택 화재보험료 충격: 해안가에서 멀어도 보험료가 계속 오르는 이유

segments.src: Opening a homeowners insurance renewal notice has become an anxious moment for many households.
segments.tr: 주택 화재보험 갱신 통지서를 받는 것은 많은 가정에 불안한 순간이 되었습니다.

segments.src: Across the country, policyholders are reporting increases of ten percent or more, and in some cases much higher, even when they have never filed a claim and live hundreds of miles from a hurricane zone.
segments.tr: 전국적으로 계약자들은 단 한 번도 보험금을 청구한 적이 없고 허리케인 지대에서 수백 마일 떨어진 곳에 살고 있음에도 불구하고 10% 이상, 어떤 경우에는 그보다 훨씬 높은 인상률을 보고하고 있습니다.

segments.src: The trend is no longer a coastal story.
segments.tr: 이러한 추세는 더 이상 해안 지역만의 이야기가 아닙니다.

segments.src: It is a national one.
segments.tr: 전국적인 현상입니다.

segments.src: This article explains the main forces behind rising premiums, why they reach inland communities, and what homeowners can realistically do about it.
segments.tr: 이 기사에서는 보험료 상승의 주요 원인, 내륙 지역까지 영향을 미치는 이유, 그리고 주택 소유자가 이에 대해 현실적으로 취할 수 있는 조치에 대해 설명합니다.

segments.src: It is general information, not personal financial or insurance advice.
segments.tr: 이는 일반적인 정보일 뿐 개인적인 재정 또는 보험 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: ## Why a Quiet Neighborhood Still Pays More
segments.tr: ## 조용한 동네에서도 보험료가 오르는 이유

segments.src: Insurance works by pooling risk.
segments.tr: 보험은 위험을 분산하는 방식으로 작동합니다.

segments.src: Premiums collected from many households fund the claims of the few who suffer losses.
segments.tr: 많은 가정에서 거둔 보험료로 손해를 입은 소수의 보험금을 지급합니다.

segments.src: When losses climb in one part of the country, the cost does not stay there.
segments.tr: 국내 한 지역에서 손실이 증가하면 그 비용은 그곳에만 머물지 않습니다.

segments.src: Insurers price on the basis of their overall results, and the companies that cover your home often operate in dozens of states.
segments.tr: 보험사는 전반적인 실적을 바탕으로 가격을 책정하며, 고객의 주택을 보장하는 회사는 종종 수십 개 주에서 영업합니다.

segments.src: A bad year in one region can lead to rate filings in many others.
segments.tr: 한 지역의 나쁜 한 해는 다른 여러 지역의 요금 인상으로 이어질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Several forces are working at once.
segments.tr: 여러 요인이 동시에 작용하고 있습니다.

segments.src: ### 1. The cost of rebuilding has gone up
segments.tr: ### 1. 재건축 비용이 상승했습니다

segments.src: Homeowners insurance is designed to pay to repair or rebuild a home.
segments.tr: 주택 보험은 주택을 수리하거나 재건축하는 비용을 지불하도록 설계되어 있습니다.

segments.src: Over the past several years, the prices of lumber, roofing materials, electrical components, and skilled labor have risen significantly compared with earlier in the decade.
segments.tr: 지난 몇 년 동안 목재, 지붕 자재, 전기 부품 및 숙련된 노동력의 가격이 이십 년대 초반에 비해 크게 올랐습니다.

segments.src: A policy that adequately covered a house a few years ago may now fall short, so insurers adjust coverage limits upward, and premiums rise with them.
segments.tr: 몇 년 전만 해도 집을 적절하게 보장하던 보험이 이제는 부족할 수 있으므로 보험사는 보장 한도를 상향 조정하고 보험료도 그에 따라 상승합니다.

segments.src: Even a small claim costs more to settle than it used to.
segments.tr: 작은 청구라도 해결하는 데 드는 비용이 예전보다 비싸졌습니다.

segments.src: Replacing a roof, repairing water damage, or restoring a kitchen takes more money and, in many places, more time because contractors are in short supply.
segments.tr: 지붕 교체, 수해 복구, 주방 복구에는 더 많은 돈이 들며, 많은 곳에서 계약자 부족으로 인해 더 많은 시간이 소요됩니다.

segments.src: ### 2. Reinsurance has become more expensive
segments.tr: ### 2. 재보험 가격이 비싸졌습니다

segments.src: Insurers buy their own insurance, called reinsurance, to protect themselves against very large events.
segments.tr: 보험사는 대형 재해로부터 스스로를 보호하기 위해 재보험이라는 자체 보험을 가입합니다.

segments.src: Reinsurers have repriced that protection after several years of heavy catastrophe losses worldwide.
segments.tr: 재보험사들은 전 세계적으로 수년간의 막대한 재해 손실을 겪은 후 해당 보장 가격을 재조정했습니다.

segments.src: When an insurer pays more for reinsurance, that expense is typically reflected in the rates it asks regulators to approve.
segments.tr: 보험사가 재보험에 더 많은 비용을 지불하면 해당 비용은 일반적으로 규제 기관에 승인을 요청하는 요율에 반영됩니다.

segments.src: Homeowners in a state that has never seen a major hurricane can therefore feel the effects of storms elsewhere.
segments.tr: 따라서 대형 허리케인을 겪어본 적이 없는 주의 주택 소유자도 다른 곳의 폭풍 영향을 느낄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ### 3. Severe weather is not just a coastal problem
segments.tr: ### 3. 악천후는 해안만의 문제가 아닙니다

segments.src: Hurricanes get the headlines, but a large share of insured losses in recent years has come from other perils: hail, tornadoes, straight-line winds, wildfire, and winter storms.
segments.tr: 허리케인이 헤드라인을 장식하지만, 최근 몇 년간 보험 손실의 큰 부분은 우박, 토네이도, 직선 바람, 산불, 겨울 폭풍 등 다른 재해로 인해 발생했습니다.

segments.src: Many of these events strike the middle of the country and the interior West.
segments.tr: 이러한 이벤트 중 상당수가 국가 중부와 내륙 서부를 강타합니다.

segments.src: Hail in particular can lead to a wave of roof claims across a metro area in a single afternoon.
segments.tr: 특히 우박은 하루 오후 동안 대도시 지역 전체에 지붕 청구 물결을 일으킬 수 있습니다.

segments.src: As these so-called secondary perils have become a bigger part of insurers' loss totals, rate increases have spread to regions that once considered themselves low-risk.
segments.tr: 이러한 이른바 이차적 위험이 보험사 손실 총액에서 더 큰 비중을 차지함에 따라 요금 인상은 한때 저위험으로 간주되었던 지역으로 확산되었습니다.

segments.src: ### 4. Inflation and legal costs add pressure
segments.tr: ### 4. 인플레이션과 소송 비용이 압박을 가중시킵니다

segments.src: General price increases affect every part of a claim, from materials to adjusters to vehicle and equipment costs.
segments.tr: 일반적인 가격 상승은 자재부터 손해사정사, 차량 및 장비 비용에 이르기까지 청구의 모든 부분에 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: In some states, litigation around claims has also added to insurers' expenses.
segments.tr: 일부 주에서는 청구 관련 소송도 보험사의 비용을 가중시켰습니다.

segments.src: Where legal costs are high, insurers say they must build that into pricing.
segments.tr: 법적 비용이 높은 곳에서는 보험사가 이를 가격에 반영해야 한다고 말합니다.

segments.src: Consumer advocates, for their part, note that disputes often arise when claims are delayed or underpaid.
segments.tr: 소비자 단체 측은 청구가 지연되거나 과소 지급될 때 분쟁이 자주 발생한다고 지적합니다.

segments.src: Both sides agree on one point: costs are rising.
segments.tr: 양측 모두 비용이 증가하고 있다는 점에 동의합니다.

segments.src: ## When Insurers Pull Back
segments.tr: ## 보험사가 발을 뺄 때

segments.src: For some homeowners the problem is not only price but availability.
segments.tr: 일부 주택 소유자에게 문제는 가격뿐만 아니라 가용성입니다.

segments.src: A number of insurers have stopped writing new policies in certain states, restricted new business in high-risk areas, or declined to renew existing policies.
segments.tr: 많은 보험사가 특정 주에서 새로운 정책 작성을 중단하거나, 고위험 지역에서 신규 영업을 제한하거나, 기존 정책 갱신을 거부했습니다.

segments.src: Reasons include repeated losses, difficulty getting rate increases approved quickly, and concerns about the age or condition of roofs.
segments.tr: 이유에는 반복되는 손실, 요금 인상 신속 승인 득점의 어려움, 지붕의 연식이나 상태에 대한 우려가 포함됩니다.

segments.src: When private coverage shrinks, more people turn to state-backed insurers of last resort, often called FAIR Plans or similar programs.
segments.tr: 민간 보장이 줄어들면 FAIR 플랜 또는 유사 프로그램이라고 불리는 최후의 수단인 주 지원 보험사로 더 많은 사람들이 눈을 돌립니다.

segments.src: These plans generally offer more limited coverage and can cost more.
segments.tr: 이러한 계획은 일반적으로 더 제한적인 보장을 제공하며 비용이 더 많이 들 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Their growth is itself a warning sign, because a large pool of high-risk policies concentrated in one program can strain the system.
segments.tr: 이들의 성장은 그 자체로 경고 신호인데, 한 프로그램에 집중된 고위험 정책의 대규모 풀이 시스템에 부담을 줄 수 있기 때문입니다.

segments.src: Mortgage lenders require coverage, so a lapse is not an option for most owners.
segments.tr: 모기지 대출 기관은 보장을 요구하므로 대부분의 소유주에게 실효는 선택 사항이 아닙니다.

segments.src: That gives homeowners little room to walk away from a high quote, which is part of why the issue feels so pressing.
segments.tr: 이로 인해 주택 소유자는 높은 견적에서 벗어날 여지가 거의 없으며, 이는 문제 가 그토록 시급하게 느껴지는 이유 중 일부입니다.

segments.src: ## What Homeowners Can Do
segments.tr: ## 주택 소유자가 할 수 있는 일

segments.src: There is no way to avoid market-wide trends, but there are practical steps that may help limit the damage.
segments.tr: 시장 전체의 추세를 피할 방법은 없지만 피해를 제한하는 데 도움이 되는 실용적인 단계가 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Shop around every year.** Quotes for the same house can differ widely between companies. An independent agent can compare several carriers at once.
segments.tr: - **매년 둘러보세요.** 동일한 집에 대한 견적은 회사마다 크게 다를 수 있습니다. 독립 대리점은 여러 통신사를 한 번에 비교할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Review your coverage, not just the price.** Make sure your dwelling limit reflects current rebuilding costs. Cutting coverage too far to save money can leave a gap after a loss.
segments.tr: - **가격뿐만 아니라 보장 내역을 검토하세요.** 주거 한도가 현재 재건축 비용을 반영하는지 확인하십시오. 돈을 아끼기 위해 보장을 너무 많이 깎으면 손실 후 공백이 생길 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Raise your deductible carefully.** A higher deductible usually lowers the premium, but only choose an amount you could pay from savings. Note that many policies now carry a separate, higher deductible for wind or hail.
segments.tr: - **공제액을 신중하게 높이세요.** 공제액이 높을수록 일반적으로 보험료가 낮아지지만 저축에서 지불할 수 있는 금액만 선택하십시오. 이제 많은 정책에 바람이나 우박에 대해 별도의 더 높은 공제액이 적용된다는 점에 유의하십시오.

segments.src: - **Invest in your roof.** Newer or impact-resistant roofing, reinforced garage doors, and properly maintained gutters can reduce risk. Ask your insurer which improvements earn discounts.
segments.tr: - **지붕에 투자하세요.** 더 새롭거나 충격에 강한 지붕, 보강된 차고 문, 적절하게 유지 관리된 홈통은 위험을 줄일 수 있습니다. 보험사에 어떤 개선 사항이 할인을 받는지 문의하세요.

segments.src: - **Add protective devices.** Water leak sensors, automatic shutoff valves, monitored alarms, and smoke detectors may qualify for credits.
segments.tr: - **보호 장치를 추가하세요.** 누수 센서, 자동 차단 밸브, 모니터링 알람 및 연기 감지기는 크레디트 자격이 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Bundle thoughtfully.** Combining home and auto coverage often brings a discount, but compare the bundled price against separate policies.
segments.tr: - **사려 깊게 묶으세요.** 주택 및 자동차 보험을 결합하면 종종 할인이 적용되지만 묶음 가격과 별도의 정책을 비교하십시오.

segments.src: - **Keep your records clean.** Document your home with photos and a home inventory. It speeds claims and helps ensure you are paid fairly.
segments.tr: - **기록을 깨끗하게 유지하세요.** 사진과 주택 인벤토리로 집을 문서화하십시오. 청구 속도를 높이고 공정하게 지불받을 수 있도록 도와줍니다.

segments.src: - **Ask about your options if you are non-renewed.** Contact your state insurance department, which can explain local choices and consumer protections.
segments.tr: - **갱신되지 않은 경우 옵션에 대해 문의하세요.** 지역 선택 및 소비자 보호를 설명할 수 있는 주 보험국에 문의하십시오.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## 더 큰 그림

segments.src: Policymakers are debating how to respond.
segments.tr: 정책 입안자들은 대응 방법에 대해 토론하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Proposals include strengthening building codes, funding programs that help owners harden their homes, reforming how states regulate rates, and improving the financial stability of state insurance pools.
segments.tr: 제안에는 건축 법규 강화, 소유주가 집을 강화하도록 돕는 자금 지원 프로그램, 주정부의 요금 규제 방식 개혁, 주 보험 풀의 재정적 안정성 개선이 포함됩니다.

segments.src: Each option involves trade-offs between affordability, insurer solvency, and consumer protection, and no single fix is expected to bring premiums back to earlier levels quickly.
segments.tr: 각 옵션에는 경제성, 보험사 지불 능력, 소비자 보호 간의 절충안이 포함되며 단일 수정으로 보험료가 이전 수준으로 빠르게 돌아올 것으로 예상되지 않습니다.

segments.src: For now, the practical takeaway is that home insurance is increasingly a cost to be managed actively rather than a bill to be paid on autopilot.
segments.tr: 현재로서는 실용적인 시사점은 주택 보험이 자동 조종 장치로 지불해야 하는 고지서라기보다는 적극적으로 관리해야 하는 비용이라는 점입니다.

segments.src: Reviewing your policy each year, understanding what it covers, and reducing your home's risk are the most reliable tools homeowners have, whether they live on the coast or hundreds of miles inland.
segments.tr: 해안가에 살든 내륙 수백 마일에 살든 매년 정책을 검토하고, 보장 내용을 이해하고, 집의 위험을 줄이는 것이 주택 소유자가 가진 가장 신뢰할 수 있는 도구입니다.

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes only and does not constitute insurance, legal, or financial advice.
segments.tr: *이 문서는 일반적인 정보 제공 목적으로만 제공되며 보험, 법률 또는 재정적 조언을 구성하지 않습니다.

segments.src: Coverage terms and prices vary by insurer and state; consult a licensed agent or your state insurance department for guidance specific to your situation.*
segments.tr: 보장 조건과 가격은 보험사와 주에 따라 다릅니다. 귀하의 상황에 특화된 지침은 면허가 있는 대리점이나 주 보험국에 문의하십시오.*

zh.title: 房屋保险费激增：为什么即使远离海岸，保费也在不断上涨

segments.src: Opening a homeowners insurance renewal notice has become an anxious moment for many households.
segments.tr: 对于许多家庭来说，收到房屋保险续保通知已成为一个令人焦虑的时刻。

segments.src: Across the country, policyholders are reporting increases of ten percent or more, and in some cases much higher, even when they have never filed a claim and live hundreds of miles from a hurricane zone.
segments.tr: 在全国范围内，投保人报告保费上涨了百分之十甚至更多，在某些情况下涨幅更高，即使他们从未提出过索赔，且居住在距离飓风区数百英里远的地方。

segments.src: The trend is no longer a coastal story.
segments.tr: 这种趋势不再仅仅是沿海地区的故事。

segments.src: It is a national one.
segments.tr: 这是一个全国性的问题。

segments.src: This article explains the main forces behind rising premiums, why they reach inland communities, and what homeowners can realistically do about it.
segments.tr: 本文解释了保费上涨背后的主要力量，为什么它们会波及内陆社区，以及房主可以采取哪些切实可行的应对措施。

segments.src: It is general information, not personal financial or insurance advice.
segments.tr: 本文仅供参考，不构成个人财务或保险建议。

segments.src: ## Why a Quiet Neighborhood Still Pays More
segments.tr: ## 为什么安静的社区也要支付更多费用

segments.src: Insurance works by pooling risk.
segments.tr: 保险的运作方式是汇集风险。

segments.src: Premiums collected from many households fund the claims of the few who suffer losses.
segments.tr: 从许多家庭收取的保费用于资助少数遭受损失者的索赔。

segments.src: When losses climb in one part of the country, the cost does not stay there.
segments.tr: 当全国某一部分地区的损失增加时，成本并不会停留在那里。

segments.src: Insurers price on the basis of their overall results, and the companies that cover your home often operate in dozens of states.
segments.tr: 保险公司根据其整体业绩进行定价，而为您房屋承保的公司通常在数十个州开展业务。

segments.src: A bad year in one region can lead to rate filings in many others.
segments.tr: 一个地区表现不佳的一年可能会导致许多其他地区的费率备案调整。

segments.src: Several forces are working at once.
segments.tr: 多种力量正在同时发挥作用。

segments.src: ### 1. The cost of rebuilding has gone up
segments.tr: ### 1. 重建成本已经上升

segments.src: Homeowners insurance is designed to pay to repair or rebuild a home.
segments.tr: 房屋保险旨在支付维修或重建房屋的费用。

segments.src: Over the past several years, the prices of lumber, roofing materials, electrical components, and skilled labor have risen significantly compared with earlier in the decade.
segments.tr: 在过去几年中，木材、屋顶材料、电气元件和熟练劳动力的价格与本世纪初相比大幅上涨。

segments.src: A policy that adequately covered a house a few years ago may now fall short, so insurers adjust coverage limits upward, and premiums rise with them.
segments.tr: 几年前能够充分覆盖房屋的保单现在可能不足以覆盖，因此保险公司会向上调整承保限额，保费也随之上升。

segments.src: Even a small claim costs more to settle than it used to.
segments.tr: 即使是小额索赔，解决成本也比过去更高。

segments.src: Replacing a roof, repairing water damage, or restoring a kitchen takes more money and, in many places, more time because contractors are in short supply.
segments.tr: 更换屋顶、修复水灾损失或翻新厨房需要更多的资金，而且在许多地方，由于承包商短缺，还需要更多的时间。

segments.src: ### 2. Reinsurance has become more expensive
segments.tr: ### 2. 再保险变得更加昂贵

segments.src: Insurers buy their own insurance, called reinsurance, to protect themselves against very large events.
segments.tr: 保险公司购买自己的保险，称为再保险，以保护自己免受重大事件的影响。

segments.src: Reinsurers have repriced that protection after several years of heavy catastrophe losses worldwide.
segments.tr: 在经历了全球范围内连续几年的重大灾难损失后，再保险公司重新调整了这种保护的价格。

segments.src: When an insurer pays more for reinsurance, that expense is typically reflected in the rates it asks regulators to approve.
segments.tr: 当保险公司为再保险支付更多费用时，这笔支出通常会反映在它要求监管机构批准的费率中。

segments.src: Homeowners in a state that has never seen a major hurricane can therefore feel the effects of storms elsewhere.
segments.tr: 因此，从未经历过大型飓风的州的房主也会感受到其他地方风暴带来的影响。

segments.src: ### 3. Severe weather is not just a coastal problem
segments.tr: ### 3. 恶劣天气不仅仅是沿海问题

segments.src: Hurricanes get the headlines, but a large share of insured losses in recent years has come from other perils: hail, tornadoes, straight-line winds, wildfire, and winter storms.
segments.tr: 飓风占据了新闻头条，但近年来很大一部分保险损失来自其他灾害：冰雹、龙卷风、直线风、野火和冬季风暴。

segments.src: Many of these events strike the middle of the country and the interior West.
segments.tr: 其中许多事件袭击了该国中部和内陆西部地区。

segments.src: Hail in particular can lead to a wave of roof claims across a metro area in a single afternoon.
segments.tr: 特别是冰雹，可能会在一个下午导致整个大都市区出现一波屋顶索赔。

segments.src: As these so-called secondary perils have become a bigger part of insurers' loss totals, rate increases have spread to regions that once considered themselves low-risk.
segments.tr: 随着这些所谓的次生灾害在保险公司损失总额中所占比例越来越大，费率上涨已蔓延至曾经认为自己处于低风险的地区。

segments.src: ### 4. Inflation and legal costs add pressure
segments.tr: ### 4. 通货膨胀和法律成本增加了压力

segments.src: General price increases affect every part of a claim, from materials to adjusters to vehicle and equipment costs.
segments.tr: 普遍的价格上涨影响了索赔的每一个环节，从材料到理算员，再到车辆和设备成本。

segments.src: In some states, litigation around claims has also added to insurers' expenses.
segments.tr: 在一些州，围绕索赔的诉讼也增加了保险公司的支出。

segments.src: Where legal costs are high, insurers say they must build that into pricing.
segments.tr: 在法律成本高昂的地方，保险公司表示必须将其计入定价中。

segments.src: Consumer advocates, for their part, note that disputes often arise when claims are delayed or underpaid.
segments.tr: 消费者权益倡导者则指出，当索赔被延迟或赔付不足时，往往会产生纠纷。

segments.src: Both sides agree on one point: costs are rising.
segments.tr: 双方在一点上达成共识：成本正在上升。

segments.src: ## When Insurers Pull Back
segments.tr: ## 当保险公司撤退时

segments.src: For some homeowners the problem is not only price but availability.
segments.tr: 对于一些房主来说，问题不仅在于价格，还在于可用性。

segments.src: A number of insurers have stopped writing new policies in certain states, restricted new business in high-risk areas, or declined to renew existing policies.
segments.tr: 许多保险公司已停止在某些州签发新保单，限制在高风险地区开展新业务，或拒绝续保现有保单。

segments.src: Reasons include repeated losses, difficulty getting rate increases approved quickly, and concerns about the age or condition of roofs.
segments.tr: 原因包括反复发生的损失、费率上涨难以快速获得批准，以及对屋顶年龄或状况的担忧。

segments.src: When private coverage shrinks, more people turn to state-backed insurers of last resort, often called FAIR Plans or similar programs.
segments.tr: 当私人保险覆盖范围缩小时，更多人转向州政府支持的最后手段保险公司，通常称为 FAIR 计划或类似项目。

segments.src: These plans generally offer more limited coverage and can cost more.
segments.tr: 这些计划通常提供更有限的承保范围，而且成本可能更高。

segments.src: Their growth is itself a warning sign, because a large pool of high-risk policies concentrated in one program can strain the system.
segments.tr: 它们的增长本身就是一个警告信号，因为集中在一个项目中的大量高风险保单可能会使系统不堪重负。

segments.src: Mortgage lenders require coverage, so a lapse is not an option for most owners.
segments.tr: 抵押贷款机构要求必须有保险，因此对于大多数业主来说，保单失效不是一个选择。

segments.src: That gives homeowners little room to walk away from a high quote, which is part of why the issue feels so pressing.
segments.tr: 这使得房主几乎没有余地去拒绝高额报价，这也是为什么这个问题让人感到如此紧迫的部分原因。

segments.src: ## What Homeowners Can Do
segments.tr: ## 房主可以做什么

segments.src: There is no way to avoid market-wide trends, but there are practical steps that may help limit the damage.
segments.tr: 无法避免市场范围内的趋势，但有一些切实可行的步骤可能有助于限制损失。

segments.src: - **Shop around every year.** Quotes for the same house can differ widely between companies. An independent agent can compare several carriers at once.
segments.tr: - **每年货比三家。** 同一栋房屋的报价在不同公司之间可能差异巨大。独立代理人可以同时比较多家保险公司。

segments.src: - **Review your coverage, not just the price.** Make sure your dwelling limit reflects current rebuilding costs. Cutting coverage too far to save money can leave a gap after a loss.
segments.tr: - **审查您的承保范围，而不仅仅是价格。** 确保您的住宅限额反映了当前的重建成本。为了省钱而过度削减承保范围可能会在损失发生后留下缺口。

segments.src: - **Raise your deductible carefully.** A higher deductible usually lowers the premium, but only choose an amount you could pay from savings. Note that many policies now carry a separate, higher deductible for wind or hail.
segments.tr: - **谨慎提高免赔额。** 更高的免赔额通常会降低保费，但只能选择您能用积蓄支付的金额。请注意，许多保单现在针对风灾或冰雹设有单独的、更高的免赔额。

segments.src: - **Invest in your roof.** Newer or impact-resistant roofing, reinforced garage doors, and properly maintained gutters can reduce risk. Ask your insurer which improvements earn discounts.
segments.tr: - **投资您的屋顶。** 更新或抗冲击的屋顶、加固的车库门以及维护良好的排水沟可以降低风险。询问您的保险公司哪些改进可以获得折扣。

segments.src: - **Add protective devices.** Water leak sensors, automatic shutoff valves, monitored alarms, and smoke detectors may qualify for credits.
segments.tr: - **增加保护装置。** 漏水传感器、自动关闭阀、监控报警器和烟雾探测器可能有资格获得保费抵扣。

segments.src: - **Bundle thoughtfully.** Combining home and auto coverage often brings a discount, but compare the bundled price against separate policies.
segments.tr: - **明智地捆绑保险。** 结合房屋和汽车保险通常会带来折扣，但请将捆绑价格与单独的保单进行比较。

segments.src: - **Keep your records clean.** Document your home with photos and a home inventory. It speeds claims and helps ensure you are paid fairly.
segments.tr: - **保持您的记录清晰。** 用照片和家庭财产清单记录您的房屋。这可以加快索赔速度，并有助于确保您获得公平的赔付。

segments.src: - **Ask about your options if you are non-renewed.** Contact your state insurance department, which can explain local choices and consumer protections.
segments.tr: - **如果您被拒绝续保，请询问您的选择。** 联系您所在州的保险部门，他们可以解释当地的选择和消费者保护措施。

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## 更大的图景

segments.src: Policymakers are debating how to respond.
segments.tr: 政策制定者正在讨论如何应对。

segments.src: Proposals include strengthening building codes, funding programs that help owners harden their homes, reforming how states regulate rates, and improving the financial stability of state insurance pools.
segments.tr: 提案包括加强建筑规范、资助帮助业主加固房屋的项目、改革各州监管费率的方式，以及提高州保险池的财务稳定性。

segments.src: Each option involves trade-offs between affordability, insurer solvency, and consumer protection, and no single fix is expected to bring premiums back to earlier levels quickly.
segments.tr: 每个选项都涉及在负担能力、保险公司偿付能力和消费者保护之间进行权衡，预计没有任何单一的解决方案能让保费迅速回到以前的水平。

segments.src: For now, the practical takeaway is that home insurance is increasingly a cost to be managed actively rather than a bill to be paid on autopilot.
segments.tr: 目前，实际的结论是，房屋保险越来越成为一种需要积极管理的成本，而不是一种可以自动支付的账单。

segments.src: Reviewing your policy each year, understanding what it covers, and reducing your home's risk are the most reliable tools homeowners have, whether they live on the coast or hundreds of miles inland.
segments.tr: 每年审查您的保单、了解其承保范围并降低房屋风险，是房主拥有的最可靠的工具，无论他们是住在沿海还是内陆数百英里外。

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes only and does not constitute insurance, legal, or financial advice.
segments.tr: *本文仅供一般参考，不构成保险、法律或财务建议。

segments.src: Coverage terms and prices vary by insurer and state; consult a licensed agent or your state insurance department for guidance specific to your situation.*
segments.tr: 承保条款和价格因保险公司和州而异；请咨询持牌代理人或您所在州的保险部门，以获取针对您具体情况的指导。*

hi.title: गृह बीमा स्टिकर शॉक: तटीय क्षेत्रों से दूर होने के बावजूद प्रीमियम क्यों बढ़ रहे हैं

segments.src: Opening a homeowners insurance renewal notice has become an anxious moment for many households.
segments.tr: गृहस्वामी बीमा नवीनीकरण नोटिस खोलना कई परिवारों के लिए चिंता का क्षण बन गया है।

segments.src: Across the country, policyholders are reporting increases of ten percent or more, and in some cases much higher, even when they have never filed a claim and live hundreds of miles from a hurricane zone.
segments.tr: पूरे देश में, पॉलिसीधारक दस प्रतिशत या उससे अधिक की वृद्धि की रिपोर्ट कर रहे हैं, और कुछ मामलों में तो यह वृद्धि और भी अधिक है, भले ही उन्होंने कभी कोई दावा (क्लेम) दायर न किया हो और वे तूफान क्षेत्र से सैकड़ों मील दूर रहते हों।

segments.src: The trend is no longer a coastal story.
segments.tr: यह प्रवृत्ति अब केवल तटीय क्षेत्रों की कहानी नहीं रह गई है।

segments.src: It is a national one.
segments.tr: यह एक राष्ट्रीय मुद्दा है।

segments.src: This article explains the main forces behind rising premiums, why they reach inland communities, and what homeowners can realistically do about it.
segments.tr: यह लेख प्रीमियम बढ़ने के पीछे के मुख्य कारणों, उनके अंतर्देशीय समुदायों तक पहुँचने के कारणों और गृहस्वामी इसके बारे में वास्तव में क्या कर सकते हैं, इस पर प्रकाश डालता है।

segments.src: It is general information, not personal financial or insurance advice.
segments.tr: यह सामान्य जानकारी है, न कि व्यक्तिगत वित्तीय या बीमा सलाह।

segments.src: ## Why a Quiet Neighborhood Still Pays More
segments.tr: ## शांत पड़ोस में भी अधिक भुगतान क्यों करना पड़ता है

segments.src: Insurance works by pooling risk.
segments.tr: बीमा जोखिम को साझा करके काम करता है।

segments.src: Premiums collected from many households fund the claims of the few who suffer losses.
segments.tr: कई परिवारों से एकत्र किया गया प्रीमियम उन कुछ लोगों के दावों को निधि देता है जिन्हें नुकसान होता है।

segments.src: When losses climb in one part of the country, the cost does not stay there.
segments.tr: जब देश के एक हिस्से में नुकसान बढ़ता है, तो लागत वहीं तक सीमित नहीं रहती।

segments.src: Insurers price on the basis of their overall results, and the companies that cover your home often operate in dozens of states.
segments.tr: बीमाकर्ता अपने समग्र परिणामों के आधार पर मूल्य निर्धारण करते हैं, और आपके घर को कवर करने वाली कंपनियाँ अक्सर दर्जनों राज्यों में काम करती हैं।

segments.src: A bad year in one region can lead to rate filings in many others.
segments.tr: एक क्षेत्र में खराब वर्ष कई अन्य क्षेत्रों में दर फाइलिंग का कारण बन सकता है।

segments.src: Several forces are working at once.
segments.tr: कई ताकतें एक साथ काम कर रही हैं।

segments.src: ### 1. The cost of rebuilding has gone up
segments.tr: ### 1. पुनर्निर्माण की लागत बढ़ गई है

segments.src: Homeowners insurance is designed to pay to repair or rebuild a home.
segments.tr: गृहस्वामी बीमा को घर की मरम्मत या पुनर्निर्माण के लिए भुगतान करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है।

segments.src: Over the past several years, the prices of lumber, roofing materials, electrical components, and skilled labor have risen significantly compared with earlier in the decade.
segments.tr: पिछले कई वर्षों में, लकड़ी, छत की सामग्री, विद्युत घटकों और कुशल श्रम की कीमतों में दशक की शुरुआत की तुलना में काफी वृद्धि हुई है।

segments.src: A policy that adequately covered a house a few years ago may now fall short, so insurers adjust coverage limits upward, and premiums rise with them.
segments.tr: जो पॉलिसी कुछ साल पहले घर को पर्याप्त रूप से कवर करती थी, वह अब कम पड़ सकती है, इसलिए बीमाकर्ता कवरेज सीमा को ऊपर की ओर समायोजित करते हैं, और प्रीमियम उनके साथ बढ़ जाते हैं।

segments.src: Even a small claim costs more to settle than it used to.
segments.tr: एक छोटे से दावे को निपटाने में भी पहले की तुलना में अधिक खर्च आता है।

segments.src: Replacing a roof, repairing water damage, or restoring a kitchen takes more money and, in many places, more time because contractors are in short supply.
segments.tr: छत बदलना, पानी से हुए नुकसान की मरम्मत करना, या रसोई को बहाल करने में अधिक पैसा और, कई जगहों पर, अधिक समय लगता है क्योंकि ठेकेदारों की कमी है।

segments.src: ### 2. Reinsurance has become more expensive
segments.tr: ### 2. पुनर्बीमा (Reinsurance) अधिक महंगा हो गया है

segments.src: Insurers buy their own insurance, called reinsurance, to protect themselves against very large events.
segments.tr: बीमाकर्ता बहुत बड़ी घटनाओं से खुद को बचाने के लिए अपना बीमा खरीदते हैं, जिसे पुनर्बीमा कहा जाता है।

segments.src: Reinsurers have repriced that protection after several years of heavy catastrophe losses worldwide.
segments.tr: पुनर्बीमाकर्ताओं ने दुनिया भर में कई वर्षों के भारी आपदा नुकसान के बाद उस सुरक्षा की कीमत फिर से तय की है।

segments.src: When an insurer pays more for reinsurance, that expense is typically reflected in the rates it asks regulators to approve.
segments.tr: जब कोई बीमाकर्ता पुनर्बीमा के लिए अधिक भुगतान करता है, तो वह खर्च आमतौर पर उन दरों में परिलक्षित होता है जिन्हें वह नियामकों से अनुमोदित करने के लिए कहता है।

segments.src: Homeowners in a state that has never seen a major hurricane can therefore feel the effects of storms elsewhere.
segments.tr: इसलिए, ऐसे राज्य के गृहस्वामी जिन्होंने कभी बड़ा तूफान नहीं देखा है, वे कहीं और आए तूफानों के प्रभावों को महसूस कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: ### 3. Severe weather is not just a coastal problem
segments.tr: ### 3. गंभीर मौसम केवल तटीय समस्या नहीं है

segments.src: Hurricanes get the headlines, but a large share of insured losses in recent years has come from other perils: hail, tornadoes, straight-line winds, wildfire, and winter storms.
segments.tr: तूफान सुर्खियां बटोरते हैं, लेकिन हाल के वर्षों में बीमित नुकसान का एक बड़ा हिस्सा अन्य खतरों से आया है: ओलावृष्टि, बवंडर, सीधी हवाएं, जंगल की आग और शीतकालीन तूफान।

segments.src: Many of these events strike the middle of the country and the interior West.
segments.tr: इनमें से कई घटनाएं देश के मध्य और आंतरिक पश्चिम में होती हैं।

segments.src: Hail in particular can lead to a wave of roof claims across a metro area in a single afternoon.
segments.tr: विशेष रूप से ओलावृष्टि एक ही दोपहर में मेट्रो क्षेत्र में छत के दावों की लहर पैदा कर सकती है।

segments.src: As these so-called secondary perils have become a bigger part of insurers' loss totals, rate increases have spread to regions that once considered themselves low-risk.
segments.tr: जैसे-जैसे ये तथाकथित माध्यमिक खतरे बीमाकर्ताओं के कुल नुकसान का एक बड़ा हिस्सा बन गए हैं, दर वृद्धि उन क्षेत्रों में फैल गई है जो कभी खुद को कम जोखिम वाला मानते थे।

segments.src: ### 4. Inflation and legal costs add pressure
segments.tr: ### 4. मुद्रास्फीति और कानूनी लागत दबाव बढ़ाती है

segments.src: General price increases affect every part of a claim, from materials to adjusters to vehicle and equipment costs.
segments.tr: सामान्य मूल्य वृद्धि दावे के हर हिस्से को प्रभावित करती है, सामग्री से लेकर समायोजकों तक, वाहन और उपकरण लागत तक।

segments.src: In some states, litigation around claims has also added to insurers' expenses.
segments.tr: कुछ राज्यों में, दावों के आसपास मुकदमेबाजी ने भी बीमाकर्ताओं के खर्चों को बढ़ा दिया है।

segments.src: Where legal costs are high, insurers say they must build that into pricing.
segments.tr: जहाँ कानूनी लागत अधिक है, बीमाकर्ता कहते हैं कि उन्हें इसे मूल्य निर्धारण में शामिल करना होगा।

segments.src: Consumer advocates, for their part, note that disputes often arise when claims are delayed or underpaid.
segments.tr: उपभोक्ता अधिवक्ता, अपनी ओर से, ध्यान देते हैं कि विवाद अक्सर तब उत्पन्न होते हैं जब दावों में देरी होती है या कम भुगतान किया जाता है।

segments.src: Both sides agree on one point: costs are rising.
segments.tr: दोनों पक्ष एक बिंदु पर सहमत हैं: लागत बढ़ रही है।

segments.src: ## When Insurers Pull Back
segments.tr: ## जब बीमाकर्ता पीछे हटते हैं

segments.src: For some homeowners the problem is not only price but availability.
segments.tr: कुछ गृहस्वामियों के लिए समस्या केवल कीमत नहीं बल्कि उपलब्धता है।

segments.src: A number of insurers have stopped writing new policies in certain states, restricted new business in high-risk areas, or declined to renew existing policies.
segments.tr: कई बीमाकर्ताओं ने कुछ राज्यों में नई पॉलिसी लिखना बंद कर दिया है, उच्च जोखिम वाले क्षेत्रों में नए व्यवसाय को प्रतिबंधित कर दिया है, या मौजूदा पॉलिसियों को नवीनीकृत करने से इनकार कर दिया है।

segments.src: Reasons include repeated losses, difficulty getting rate increases approved quickly, and concerns about the age or condition of roofs.
segments.tr: कारणों में बार-बार होने वाला नुकसान, दर वृद्धि को जल्दी से अनुमोदित कराने में कठिनाई, और छतों की उम्र या स्थिति के बारे में चिंताएं शामिल हैं।

segments.src: When private coverage shrinks, more people turn to state-backed insurers of last resort, often called FAIR Plans or similar programs.
segments.tr: जब निजी कवरेज सिकुड़ता है, तो अधिक लोग अंतिम उपाय के राज्य-समर्थित बीमाकर्ताओं की ओर रुख करते हैं, जिन्हें अक्सर FAIR प्लान या समान कार्यक्रम कहा जाता है।

segments.src: These plans generally offer more limited coverage and can cost more.
segments.tr: ये योजनाएं आम तौर पर अधिक सीमित कवरेज प्रदान करती हैं और अधिक महंगी हो सकती हैं।

segments.src: Their growth is itself a warning sign, because a large pool of high-risk policies concentrated in one program can strain the system.
segments.tr: उनका विकास अपने आप में एक चेतावनी संकेत है, क्योंकि एक कार्यक्रम में केंद्रित उच्च जोखिम वाली पॉलिसियों का एक बड़ा पूल सिस्टम पर दबाव डाल सकता है।

segments.src: Mortgage lenders require coverage, so a lapse is not an option for most owners.
segments.tr: बंधक ऋणदाता कवरेज की मांग करते हैं, इसलिए अधिकांश मालिकों के लिए चूक (lapse) कोई विकल्प नहीं है।

segments.src: That gives homeowners little room to walk away from a high quote, which is part of why the issue feels so pressing.
segments.tr: यह गृहस्वामियों को उच्च कोटेशन से दूर जाने के लिए बहुत कम जगह देता है, जो इस बात का हिस्सा है कि यह मुद्दा इतना दबावपूर्ण क्यों लगता है।

segments.src: ## What Homeowners Can Do
segments.tr: ## गृहस्वामी क्या कर सकते हैं

segments.src: There is no way to avoid market-wide trends, but there are practical steps that may help limit the damage.
segments.tr: बाजार-व्यापी प्रवृत्तियों से बचने का कोई तरीका नहीं है, लेकिन ऐसे व्यावहारिक कदम हैं जो नुकसान को सीमित करने में मदद कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Shop around every year.** Quotes for the same house can differ widely between companies. An independent agent can compare several carriers at once.
segments.tr: - **हर साल खरीदारी करें।** एक ही घर के लिए कोटेशन कंपनियों के बीच व्यापक रूप से भिन्न हो सकते हैं। एक स्वतंत्र एजेंट एक साथ कई वाहकों की तुलना कर सकता है।

segments.src: - **Review your coverage, not just the price.** Make sure your dwelling limit reflects current rebuilding costs. Cutting coverage too far to save money can leave a gap after a loss.
segments.tr: - **अपने कवरेज की समीक्षा करें, न कि केवल कीमत की।** सुनिश्चित करें कि आपकी आवास सीमा वर्तमान पुनर्निर्माण लागत को दर्शाती है। पैसे बचाने के लिए कवरेज को बहुत अधिक काटना नुकसान के बाद एक अंतर छोड़ सकता है।

segments.src: - **Raise your deductible carefully.** A higher deductible usually lowers the premium, but only choose an amount you could pay from savings. Note that many policies now carry a separate, higher deductible for wind or hail.
segments.tr: - **अपनी कटौती (deductible) को सावधानीपूर्वक बढ़ाएं।** एक उच्च कटौती आमतौर पर प्रीमियम को कम करती है, लेकिन केवल वही राशि चुनें जिसे आप बचत से भुगतान कर सकें। ध्यान दें कि कई पॉलिसियों में अब हवा या ओलावृष्टि के लिए एक अलग, उच्च कटौती होती है।

segments.src: - **Invest in your roof.** Newer or impact-resistant roofing, reinforced garage doors, and properly maintained gutters can reduce risk. Ask your insurer which improvements earn discounts.
segments.tr: - **अपनी छत में निवेश करें।** नई या प्रभाव-प्रतिरोधी छत, प्रबलित गैरेज के दरवाजे, और ठीक से बनाए गए गटर जोखिम को कम कर सकते हैं। अपने बीमाकर्ता से पूछें कि कौन से सुधार छूट अर्जित करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Add protective devices.** Water leak sensors, automatic shutoff valves, monitored alarms, and smoke detectors may qualify for credits.
segments.tr: - **सुरक्षात्मक उपकरण जोड़ें।** पानी के रिसाव सेंसर, स्वचालित शटऑफ वाल्व, मॉनिटर किए गए अलार्म और स्मोक डिटेक्टर क्रेडिट के लिए अर्हता प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Bundle thoughtfully.** Combining home and auto coverage often brings a discount, but compare the bundled price against separate policies.
segments.tr: - **सोच-समझकर बंडल करें।** घर और ऑटो कवरेज को संयोजित करने से अक्सर छूट मिलती है, लेकिन बंडल की गई कीमत की तुलना अलग-अलग पॉलिसियों से करें।

segments.src: - **Keep your records clean.** Document your home with photos and a home inventory. It speeds claims and helps ensure you are paid fairly.
segments.tr: - **अपने रिकॉर्ड साफ रखें।** तस्वीरों और घर की सूची के साथ अपने घर का दस्तावेजीकरण करें। यह दावों में तेजी लाता है और यह सुनिश्चित करने में मदद करता है कि आपको उचित भुगतान किया जाए।

segments.src: - **Ask about your options if you are non-renewed.** Contact your state insurance department, which can explain local choices and consumer protections.
segments.tr: - **यदि आपको नवीनीकृत नहीं किया गया है तो अपने विकल्पों के बारे में पूछें।** अपने राज्य के बीमा विभाग से संपर्क करें, जो स्थानीय विकल्पों और उपभोक्ता सुरक्षा की व्याख्या कर सकता है।

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## बड़ी तस्वीर

segments.src: Policymakers are debating how to respond.
segments.tr: नीति निर्माता इस बात पर बहस कर रहे हैं कि कैसे प्रतिक्रिया दी जाए।

segments.src: Proposals include strengthening building codes, funding programs that help owners harden their homes, reforming how states regulate rates, and improving the financial stability of state insurance pools.
segments.tr: प्रस्तावों में निर्माण कोड को मजबूत करना, उन कार्यक्रमों को निधि देना जो मालिकों को अपने घरों को मजबूत करने में मदद करते हैं, राज्य दरों को कैसे विनियमित करते हैं, इसमें सुधार करना और राज्य बीमा पूल की वित्तीय स्थिरता में सुधार करना शामिल है।

segments.src: Each option involves trade-offs between affordability, insurer solvency, and consumer protection, and no single fix is expected to bring premiums back to earlier levels quickly.
segments.tr: प्रत्येक विकल्प में सामर्थ्य, बीमाकर्ता की सॉल्वेंसी और उपभोक्ता सुरक्षा के बीच ट्रेड-ऑफ शामिल है, और किसी भी एक समाधान से प्रीमियम को जल्दी से पहले के स्तर पर वापस लाने की उम्मीद नहीं है।

segments.src: For now, the practical takeaway is that home insurance is increasingly a cost to be managed actively rather than a bill to be paid on autopilot.
segments.tr: अभी के लिए, व्यावहारिक निष्कर्ष यह है कि गृह बीमा तेजी से एक ऐसी लागत है जिसे ऑटोपायलट पर भुगतान किए जाने वाले बिल के बजाय सक्रिय रूप से प्रबंधित किया जाना चाहिए।

segments.src: Reviewing your policy each year, understanding what it covers, and reducing your home's risk are the most reliable tools homeowners have, whether they live on the coast or hundreds of miles inland.
segments.tr: हर साल अपनी पॉलिसी की समीक्षा करना, यह समझना कि यह क्या कवर करती है, और अपने घर के जोखिम को कम करना गृहस्वामियों के पास सबसे विश्वसनीय उपकरण हैं, चाहे वे तट पर रहते हों या सैकड़ों मील अंतर्देशीय।

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes only and does not constitute insurance, legal, or financial advice.
segments.tr: *यह लेख केवल सामान्य सूचनात्मक उद्देश्यों के लिए है और बीमा, कानूनी या वित्तीय सलाह का गठन नहीं करता है।

segments.src: Coverage terms and prices vary by insurer and state; consult a licensed agent or your state insurance department for guidance specific to your situation.*
segments.tr: कवरेज की शर्तें और कीमतें बीमाकर्ता और राज्य के अनुसार भिन्न होती हैं; अपनी स्थिति के लिए विशिष्ट मार्गदर्शन के लिए किसी लाइसेंस प्राप्त एजेंट या अपने राज्य के बीमा विभाग से परामर्श करें.*

es.title: Choque por el aumento del seguro de hogar: por qué las primas siguen subiendo, incluso lejos de la costa

segments.src: Opening a homeowners insurance renewal notice has become an anxious moment for many households.
segments.tr: Abrir un aviso de renovación del seguro de hogar se ha convertido en un momento de ansiedad para muchos hogares.

segments.src: Across the country, policyholders are reporting increases of ten percent or more, and in some cases much higher, even when they have never filed a claim and live hundreds of miles from a hurricane zone.
segments.tr: En todo el país, los asegurados reportan aumentos del diez por ciento o más, y en algunos casos mucho mayores, incluso cuando nunca han presentado un reclamo y viven a cientos de millas de una zona de huracanes.

segments.src: The trend is no longer a coastal story.
segments.tr: La tendencia ya no es una historia costera.

segments.src: It is a national one.
segments.tr: Es una historia nacional.

segments.src: This article explains the main forces behind rising premiums, why they reach inland communities, and what homeowners can realistically do about it.
segments.tr: Este artículo explica las principales fuerzas detrás del aumento de las primas, por qué llegan a las comunidades del interior y qué pueden hacer los propietarios de manera realista al respecto.

segments.src: It is general information, not personal financial or insurance advice.
segments.tr: Es información general, no asesoramiento financiero o de seguros personal.

segments.src: ## Why a Quiet Neighborhood Still Pays More
segments.tr: ## Por qué un vecindario tranquilo sigue pagando más

segments.src: Insurance works by pooling risk.
segments.tr: El seguro funciona agrupando el riesgo.

segments.src: Premiums collected from many households fund the claims of the few who suffer losses.
segments.tr: Las primas recaudadas de muchos hogares financian los reclamos de los pocos que sufren pérdidas.

segments.src: When losses climb in one part of the country, the cost does not stay there.
segments.tr: Cuando las pérdidas aumentan en una parte del país, el costo no se queda allí.

segments.src: Insurers price on the basis of their overall results, and the companies that cover your home often operate in dozens of states.
segments.tr: Las aseguradoras fijan precios sobre la base de sus resultados generales, y las empresas que cubren su hogar a menudo operan en docenas de estados.

segments.src: A bad year in one region can lead to rate filings in many others.
segments.tr: Un mal año en una región puede llevar a solicitudes de tarifas en muchas otras.

segments.src: Several forces are working at once.
segments.tr: Varias fuerzas están actuando a la vez.

segments.src: ### 1. The cost of rebuilding has gone up
segments.tr: ### 1. El costo de reconstrucción ha subido

segments.src: Homeowners insurance is designed to pay to repair or rebuild a home.
segments.tr: El seguro de hogar está diseñado para pagar la reparación o reconstrucción de una vivienda.

segments.src: Over the past several years, the prices of lumber, roofing materials, electrical components, and skilled labor have risen significantly compared with earlier in the decade.
segments.tr: En los últimos años, los precios de la madera, los materiales para techos, los componentes eléctricos y la mano de obra calificada han aumentado significativamente en comparación con principios de la década.

segments.src: A policy that adequately covered a house a few years ago may now fall short, so insurers adjust coverage limits upward, and premiums rise with them.
segments.tr: Una póliza que cubría adecuadamente una casa hace unos años puede quedarse corta ahora, por lo que las aseguradoras ajustan los límites de cobertura al alza y las primas aumentan con ellos.

segments.src: Even a small claim costs more to settle than it used to.
segments.tr: Incluso un reclamo pequeño cuesta más de resolver de lo que solía costar.

segments.src: Replacing a roof, repairing water damage, or restoring a kitchen takes more money and, in many places, more time because contractors are in short supply.
segments.tr: Reemplazar un techo, reparar daños por agua o restaurar una cocina requiere más dinero y, en muchos lugares, más tiempo porque los contratistas escasean.

segments.src: ### 2. Reinsurance has become more expensive
segments.tr: ### 2. El reaseguro se ha vuelto más caro

segments.src: Insurers buy their own insurance, called reinsurance, to protect themselves against very large events.
segments.tr: Las aseguradoras compran su propio seguro, llamado reaseguro, para protegerse contra eventos muy grandes.

segments.src: Reinsurers have repriced that protection after several years of heavy catastrophe losses worldwide.
segments.tr: Los reaseguradores han vuelto a fijar el precio de esa protección después de varios años de grandes pérdidas por catástrofes en todo el mundo.

segments.src: When an insurer pays more for reinsurance, that expense is typically reflected in the rates it asks regulators to approve.
segments.tr: Cuando una aseguradora paga más por el reaseguro, ese gasto generalmente se refleja en las tarifas que pide a los reguladores que aprueben.

segments.src: Homeowners in a state that has never seen a major hurricane can therefore feel the effects of storms elsewhere.
segments.tr: Por lo tanto, los propietarios de viviendas en un estado que nunca ha visto un huracán importante pueden sentir los efectos de las tormentas en otros lugares.

segments.src: ### 3. Severe weather is not just a coastal problem
segments.tr: ### 3. El clima severo no es solo un problema costero

segments.src: Hurricanes get the headlines, but a large share of insured losses in recent years has come from other perils: hail, tornadoes, straight-line winds, wildfire, and winter storms.
segments.tr: Los huracanes ocupan los titulares, pero una gran parte de las pérdidas aseguradas en los últimos años proviene de otros peligros: granizo, tornados, vientos en línea recta, incendios forestales y tormentas invernales.

segments.src: Many of these events strike the middle of the country and the interior West.
segments.tr: Muchos de estos eventos golpean el centro del país y el interior del Oeste.

segments.src: Hail in particular can lead to a wave of roof claims across a metro area in a single afternoon.
segments.tr: El granizo en particular puede provocar una ola de reclamos por techos en toda un área metropolitana en una sola tarde.

segments.src: As these so-called secondary perils have become a bigger part of insurers' loss totals, rate increases have spread to regions that once considered themselves low-risk.
segments.tr: A medida que estos llamados peligros secundarios se han convertido en una parte mayor de los totales de pérdidas de las aseguradoras, los aumentos de tarifas se han extendido a regiones que alguna vez se consideraron de bajo riesgo.

segments.src: ### 4. Inflation and legal costs add pressure
segments.tr: ### 4. La inflación y los costos legales añaden presión

segments.src: General price increases affect every part of a claim, from materials to adjusters to vehicle and equipment costs.
segments.tr: Los aumentos generales de precios afectan a cada parte de un reclamo, desde los materiales hasta los ajustadores y los costos de vehículos y equipos.

segments.src: In some states, litigation around claims has also added to insurers' expenses.
segments.tr: En algunos estados, los litigios en torno a los reclamos también han aumentado los gastos de las aseguradoras.

segments.src: Where legal costs are high, insurers say they must build that into pricing.
segments.tr: Donde los costos legales son altos, las aseguradoras dicen que deben incorporarlos en los precios.

segments.src: Consumer advocates, for their part, note that disputes often arise when claims are delayed or underpaid.
segments.tr: Los defensores del consumidor, por su parte, señalan que las disputas a menudo surgen cuando los reclamos se retrasan o se pagan por debajo de lo debido.

segments.src: Both sides agree on one point: costs are rising.
segments.tr: Ambas partes están de acuerdo en un punto: los costos están aumentando.

segments.src: ## When Insurers Pull Back
segments.tr: ## Cuando las aseguradoras se retiran

segments.src: For some homeowners the problem is not only price but availability.
segments.tr: Para algunos propietarios, el problema no es solo el precio, sino la disponibilidad.

segments.src: A number of insurers have stopped writing new policies in certain states, restricted new business in high-risk areas, or declined to renew existing policies.
segments.tr: Varias aseguradoras han dejado de emitir nuevas pólizas en ciertos estados, han restringido nuevos negocios en áreas de alto riesgo o se han negado a renovar las pólizas existentes.

segments.src: Reasons include repeated losses, difficulty getting rate increases approved quickly, and concerns about the age or condition of roofs.
segments.tr: Las razones incluyen pérdidas repetidas, dificultad para obtener la aprobación rápida de aumentos de tarifas y preocupaciones sobre la antigüedad o el estado de los techos.

segments.src: When private coverage shrinks, more people turn to state-backed insurers of last resort, often called FAIR Plans or similar programs.
segments.tr: Cuando la cobertura privada se reduce, más personas recurren a aseguradoras estatales de último recurso, a menudo llamadas Planes FAIR o programas similares.

segments.src: These plans generally offer more limited coverage and can cost more.
segments.tr: Estos planes generalmente ofrecen una cobertura más limitada y pueden costar más.

segments.src: Their growth is itself a warning sign, because a large pool of high-risk policies concentrated in one program can strain the system.
segments.tr: Su crecimiento es en sí mismo una señal de advertencia, porque un gran grupo de pólizas de alto riesgo concentradas en un solo programa puede tensar el sistema.

segments.src: Mortgage lenders require coverage, so a lapse is not an option for most owners.
segments.tr: Los prestamistas hipotecarios requieren cobertura, por lo que dejarla caducar no es una opción para la mayoría de los propietarios.

segments.src: That gives homeowners little room to walk away from a high quote, which is part of why the issue feels so pressing.
segments.tr: Eso deja a los propietarios con poco margen para rechazar una cotización alta, lo cual es parte de por qué el problema se siente tan urgente.

segments.src: ## What Homeowners Can Do
segments.tr: ## Qué pueden hacer los propietarios

segments.src: There is no way to avoid market-wide trends, but there are practical steps that may help limit the damage.
segments.tr: No hay forma de evitar las tendencias de todo el mercado, pero hay pasos prácticos que pueden ayudar a limitar el daño.

segments.src: - **Shop around every year.** Quotes for the same house can differ widely between companies. An independent agent can compare several carriers at once.
segments.tr: - **Compare precios cada año.** Las cotizaciones para la misma casa pueden diferir ampliamente entre empresas. Un agente independiente puede comparar varias aseguradoras a la vez.

segments.src: - **Review your coverage, not just the price.** Make sure your dwelling limit reflects current rebuilding costs. Cutting coverage too far to save money can leave a gap after a loss.
segments.tr: - **Revise su cobertura, no solo el precio.** Asegúrese de que su límite de vivienda refleje los costos de reconstrucción actuales. Recortar demasiado la cobertura para ahorrar dinero puede dejar una brecha después de una pérdida.

segments.src: - **Raise your deductible carefully.** A higher deductible usually lowers the premium, but only choose an amount you could pay from savings. Note that many policies now carry a separate, higher deductible for wind or hail.
segments.tr: - **Aumente su deducible con cuidado.** Un deducible más alto generalmente reduce la prima, pero elija solo una cantidad que pueda pagar con sus ahorros. Tenga en cuenta que muchas pólizas ahora tienen un deducible separado y más alto para viento o granizo.

segments.src: - **Invest in your roof.** Newer or impact-resistant roofing, reinforced garage doors, and properly maintained gutters can reduce risk. Ask your insurer which improvements earn discounts.
segments.tr: - **Invierta en su techo.** Los techos más nuevos o resistentes a impactos, las puertas de garaje reforzadas y las canaletas bien mantenidas pueden reducir el riesgo. Pregunte a su aseguradora qué mejoras obtienen descuentos.

segments.src: - **Add protective devices.** Water leak sensors, automatic shutoff valves, monitored alarms, and smoke detectors may qualify for credits.
segments.tr: - **Agregue dispositivos de protección.** Los sensores de fugas de agua, las válvulas de cierre automático, las alarmas monitoreadas y los detectores de humo pueden calificar para créditos.

segments.src: - **Bundle thoughtfully.** Combining home and auto coverage often brings a discount, but compare the bundled price against separate policies.
segments.tr: - **Combine pólizas con cuidado.** Combinar la cobertura de hogar y auto a menudo trae un descuento, pero compare el precio combinado con las pólizas por separado.

segments.src: - **Keep your records clean.** Document your home with photos and a home inventory. It speeds claims and helps ensure you are paid fairly.
segments.tr: - **Mantenga sus registros limpios.** Documente su hogar con fotos y un inventario de la casa. Acelera los reclamos y ayuda a garantizar que se le pague de manera justa.

segments.src: - **Ask about your options if you are non-renewed.** Contact your state insurance department, which can explain local choices and consumer protections.
segments.tr: - **Pregunte sobre sus opciones si no le renuevan.** Comuníquese con el departamento de seguros de su estado, que puede explicarle las opciones locales y las protecciones al consumidor.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## El panorama general

segments.src: Policymakers are debating how to respond.
segments.tr: Los legisladores están debatiendo cómo responder.

segments.src: Proposals include strengthening building codes, funding programs that help owners harden their homes, reforming how states regulate rates, and improving the financial stability of state insurance pools.
segments.tr: Las propuestas incluyen fortalecer los códigos de construcción, financiar programas que ayuden a los propietarios a proteger sus hogares, reformar la forma en que los estados regulan las tarifas y mejorar la estabilidad financiera de los fondos estatales de seguros.

segments.src: Each option involves trade-offs between affordability, insurer solvency, and consumer protection, and no single fix is expected to bring premiums back to earlier levels quickly.
segments.tr: Cada opción implica compensaciones entre asequibilidad, solvencia de la aseguradora y protección del consumidor, y no se espera que ninguna solución única devuelva las primas a los niveles anteriores rápidamente.

segments.src: For now, the practical takeaway is that home insurance is increasingly a cost to be managed actively rather than a bill to be paid on autopilot.
segments.tr: Por ahora, la conclusión práctica es que el seguro de hogar es cada vez más un costo que debe gestionarse activamente en lugar de una factura que se paga en piloto automático.

segments.src: Reviewing your policy each year, understanding what it covers, and reducing your home's risk are the most reliable tools homeowners have, whether they live on the coast or hundreds of miles inland.
segments.tr: Revisar su póliza cada año, comprender lo que cubre y reducir el riesgo de su hogar son las herramientas más confiables que tienen los propietarios, ya sea que vivan en la costa o a cientos de millas tierra adentro.

ar.title: صدمة ملصقات تأمين المنازل: لماذا تستمر الأقساط في الارتفاع، حتى بعيداً عن الساحل

segments.src: Opening a homeowners insurance renewal notice has become an anxious moment for many households.
segments.tr: أصبح فتح إشعار تجديد تأمين أصحاب المنازل لحظة مقلقة للعديد من العائلات.

segments.src: Across the country, policyholders are reporting increases of ten percent or more, and in some cases much higher, even when they have never filed a claim and live hundreds of miles from a hurricane zone.
segments.tr: في جميع أنحاء البلاد، يبلغ حاملوا الوثائق عن زيادات بنسبة عشرة بالمائة أو أكثر، وفي بعض الحالات أعلى بكثير، حتى عندما لم يتقدموا قط بأي مطالبة ويعيشون على بعد مئات الأميال من منطقة الأعاصير.

segments.src: The trend is no longer a coastal story.
segments.tr: لم يعد هذا الاتجاه قصة ساحلية.

segments.src: It is a national one.
segments.tr: إنه اتجاه وطني.

segments.src: This article explains the main forces behind rising premiums, why they reach inland communities, and what homeowners can realistically do about it.
segments.tr: يشرح هذا المقال القوى الرئيسية الكامنة وراء ارتفاع الأقساط، ولماذا تصل إلى المجتمعات الداخلية، وما يمكن لأصحاب المنازل القيام به واقعياً حيال ذلك.

segments.src: It is general information, not personal financial or insurance advice.
segments.tr: هذه معلومات عامة وليست نصيحة مالية أو تأمينية شخصية.

segments.src: ## Why a Quiet Neighborhood Still Pays More
segments.tr: ## لماذا لا يزال الحي الهادئ يدفع أكثر

segments.src: Insurance works by pooling risk.
segments.tr: يعمل التأمين عن طريق تجميع المخاطر.

segments.src: Premiums collected from many households fund the claims of the few who suffer losses.
segments.tr: الأقساط التي يتم جمعها من العديد من الأسر تمول مطالبات القلة الذين يتعرضون للخسائر.

segments.src: When losses climb in one part of the country, the cost does not stay there.
segments.tr: عندما ترتفع الخسائر في جزء واحد من البلاد، فإن التكلفة لا تبقى هناك.

segments.src: Insurers price on the basis of their overall results, and the companies that cover your home often operate in dozens of states.
segments.tr: تقوم شركات التأمين بالتسعير على أساس نتائجها الإجمالية، وغالباً ما تعمل الشركات التي تغطي منزلك في عشرات الولايات.

segments.src: A bad year in one region can lead to rate filings in many others.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تؤدي سنة سيئة في منطقة واحدة إلى تقديم طلبات أسعار في مناطق أخرى عديدة.

segments.src: Several forces are working at once.
segments.tr: تعمل عدة قوى في نفس الوقت.

segments.src: ### 1. The cost of rebuilding has gone up
segments.tr: ### 1. ارتفعت تكلفة إعادة البناء

segments.src: Homeowners insurance is designed to pay to repair or rebuild a home.
segments.tr: تم تصميم تأمين أصحاب المنازل لدفع تكاليف إصلاح أو إعادة بناء المنزل.

segments.src: Over the past several years, the prices of lumber, roofing materials, electrical components, and skilled labor have risen significantly compared with earlier in the decade.
segments.tr: على مدى السنوات القليلة الماضية، ارتفعت أسعار الأخشاب ومواد التسقيف والمكونات الكهربائية والعمالة الماهرة بشكل كبير مقارنة ببداية العقد.

segments.src: A policy that adequately covered a house a few years ago may now fall short, so insurers adjust coverage limits upward, and premiums rise with them.
segments.tr: الوثيقة التي كانت تغطي المنزل بشكل كافٍ قبل بضع سنوات قد تقصر الآن، لذلك تقوم شركات التأمين بتعديل حدود التغطية نحو الأعلى، وترتفع الأقساط معها.

segments.src: Even a small claim costs more to settle than it used to.
segments.tr: حتى المطالبة الصغيرة تكلف أكثر للتسوية مما كانت عليه في السابق.

segments.src: Replacing a roof, repairing water damage, or restoring a kitchen takes more money and, in many places, more time because contractors are in short supply.
segments.tr: استبدال السقف، أو إصلاح أضرار المياه، أو ترميم المطبخ يتطلب أموالاً أكثر، وفي أماكن كثيرة، وقتاً أطول لأن المقاولين نادرون.

segments.src: ### 2. Reinsurance has become more expensive
segments.tr: ### 2. أصبح إعادة التأمين أكثر تكلفة

segments.src: Insurers buy their own insurance, called reinsurance, to protect themselves against very large events.
segments.tr: تشتري شركات التأمين تأمينها الخاص، المسمى بإعادة التأمين، لحماية نفسها ضد الأحداث الكبيرة جداً.

segments.src: Reinsurers have repriced that protection after several years of heavy catastrophe losses worldwide.
segments.tr: أعاد معيدو التأمين تسعير تلك الحماية بعد عدة سنوات من الخسائر الكارثية الفادحة في جميع أنحاء العالم.

segments.src: When an insurer pays more for reinsurance, that expense is typically reflected in the rates it asks regulators to approve.
segments.tr: عندما تدفع شركة التأمين أكثر مقابل إعادة التأمين، تنعكس تلك التكلفة عادةً في الأسعار التي تطلب من الجهات التنظيمية الموافقة عليها.

segments.src: Homeowners in a state that has never seen a major hurricane can therefore feel the effects of storms elsewhere.
segments.tr: لذلك يمكن لأصحاب المنازل في ولاية لم تشهد قط إعصاراً كبيراً أن يشعروا بآثار العواصف في أماكن أخرى.

segments.src: ### 3. Severe weather is not just a coastal problem
segments.tr: ### 3. الطقس القاسي ليس مشكلة ساحلية فقط

segments.src: Hurricanes get the headlines, but a large share of insured losses in recent years has come from other perils: hail, tornadoes, straight-line winds, wildfire, and winter storms.
segments.tr: تحظى الأعاصير بعناوين الصحف، لكن نسبة كبيرة من الخسائر المؤمن عليها في السنوات الأخيرة جاءت من أخطار أخرى: البرد، والأعاصير القمعية، والرياح المستقيمة، وحرائق الغابات، العواصف الشتوية.

segments.src: Many of these events strike the middle of the country and the interior West.
segments.tr: العديد من هذه الأحداث تضرب وسط البلاد والغرب الداخلي.

segments.src: Hail in particular can lead to a wave of roof claims across a metro area in a single afternoon.
segments.tr: يمكن أن يؤدي البرد على وجه الخصوص إلى موجة من مطالبات الأسقف عبر منطقة حضرية في فترة ما بعد ظهر واحدة.

segments.src: As these so-called secondary perils have become a bigger part of insurers' loss totals, rate increases have spread to regions that once considered themselves low-risk.
segments.tr: مع اصبح هذه ما تسمى بالأخطار الثانوية جزءاً أكبر من إجمالي خسائر شركات التأمين، فقد انتشرت زيادات الأسعار إلى المناطق التي كانت تعتبر نفسها ذات يوم منخفضة المخاطر.

segments.src: ### 4. Inflation and legal costs add pressure
segments.tr: ### 4. التضخم والالتزامات القانونية تضيف ضغطاً

segments.src: General price increases affect every part of a claim, from materials to adjusters to vehicle and equipment costs.
segments.tr: تؤثر زيادات الأسعار العامة على كل جزء من المطالبة، من المواد إلى المقدرين إلى تكاليف المركبات والمعدات.

segments.src: In some states, litigation around claims has also added to insurers' expenses.
segments.tr: في بعض الولايات، أضاف التقاضي حول المطالبات أيضاً إلى نفقات شركات التأمين.

segments.src: Where legal costs are high, insurers say they must build that into pricing.
segments.tr: حيث تكون التكاليف القانونية مرتفعة، تقول شركات التأمين إنه يجب عليها بناء ذلك في التسعير.

segments.src: Consumer advocates, for their part, note that disputes often arise when claims are delayed or underpaid.
segments.tr: يشير المدافعون عن المستهلكين، من جانبهم، إلى أن النزاعات تنشأ غالباً عندما يتم تأخير المطالبات أو دفع مبالغ أقل من المستحق.

segments.src: Both sides agree on one point: costs are rising.
segments.tr: يتفق الطرفان على نقطة واحدة: التكاليف في ارتفعت.

segments.src: ## When Insurers Pull Back
segments.tr: ## عندما تتراجع شركات التأمين

segments.src: For some homeowners the problem is not only price but availability.
segments.tr: بالنسبة لبعض أصحاب المنازل، فإن المشكلة ليست في السعر فحسب بل في التوفر أيضاً.

segments.src: A number of insurers have stopped writing new policies in certain states, restricted new business in high-risk areas, or declined to renew existing policies.
segments.tr: توقفت عدد من شركات التأمين عن كتابة وثائق جديدة في بعض الولايات، أو قيدت الأعمال الجديدة في المناطق عالية المخاطر، أو امتنعت عن تجديد الوثائق الحالية.

segments.src: Reasons include repeated losses, difficulty getting rate increases approved quickly, and concerns about the age or condition of roofs.
segments.tr: تشمل الأسباب الخسائر المتكررة، وصوبة الحصول على الموافقة على زيادات الأسعار بسرعة، والمخاوف بشأن عمر أو حالة الأسقف.

segments.src: When private coverage shrinks, more people turn to state-backed insurers of last resort, often called FAIR Plans or similar programs.
segments.tr: عندما تنكمش التغطية الخاصة، يلجأ المزيد من الناس إلى شركات التأمين المدعومة من الدولة كملاذ أخير، وغالباً ما تسمى خطط FAIR أو ما يشابهها من برامج.

segments.src: These plans generally offer more limited coverage and can cost more.
segments.tr: تقدم هذه الخطط عموماً تغطية أكثر محدودية ويمكن أن تكون أكثر تكلفة.

segments.src: Their growth is itself a warning sign, because a large pool of high-risk policies concentrated in one program can strain the system.
segments.tr: نموها بحد ذاته علامة تحذير، لأن مجموعة كبيرة من الوثائق عالية المخاطر المركزة في برنامج واحد يمكن أن تجهد النظام.

segments.src: Mortgage lenders require coverage, so a lapse is not an option for most owners.
segments.tr: يشترط المقرضون العقاريون التغطية، لذا فإن الانقطاع ليس خياراً لمعظم المالكين.

segments.src: That gives homeowners little room to walk away from a high quote, which is part of why the issue feels so pressing.
segments.tr: هذا يترك لأصحاب المنازل مساحة ضئيلة للابتعاد عن عرض مرتفع، وهذا جزء من سبب شعور المشكلة بأنها ملحة للغاية.

segments.src: ## What Homeowners Can Do
segments.tr: ## ما يمكن لأصحاب المنازل القيام به

segments.src: There is no way to avoid market-wide trends, but there are practical steps that may help limit the damage.
segments.tr: لا توجد طريقة لتجنب الاتجاهات على مستوى السوق، ولكن هناك خطوات عمليّة قد تساعد في الحد من الضرر.

segments.src: - **Shop around every year.** Quotes for the same house can differ widely between companies. An independent agent can compare several carriers at once.
segments.tr: - **تسوق حولك كل عام.** يمكن أن تختلف عروض الأسعار لنفس المنزل بشكل كبير بين الشركات. يمكن لوكيل مستقل مقارنة عدة شركات نقل في وقت واحد.

segments.src: - **Review your coverage, not just the price.** Make sure your dwelling limit reflects current rebuilding costs. Cutting coverage too far to save money can leave a gap after a loss.
segments.tr: - **راجع تغطيتك، وليس السعر فقط.** تأكد من أن حد مسكنك يعكس تكاليف إعادة البناء الحالية. قطع التغطية كثيراً لتوفير المال يمكن أن يترك فجوة بعد الخسارة.

segments.src: - **Raise your deductible carefully.** A higher deductible usually lowers the premium, but only choose an amount you could pay from savings. Note that many policies now carry a separate, higher deductible for wind or hail.
segments.tr: - **ارفع خصمك بحذر.** عادة ما يخفض الخصم الأعلى القسط، ولكن اختر فقط المبلغ الذي يمكنك دفعه من المدخرات. لاحظ أن العديد من الوثائق تحمل الآن خصماً منفصلاً وأعلى للرياح أو البرد.

segments.src: - **Invest in your roof.** Newer or impact-resistant roofing, reinforced garage doors, and properly maintained gutters can reduce risk. Ask your insurer which improvements earn discounts.
segments.tr: - **استثمر في سقفك.** يمكن أن تقلل الأسقف الأحدث أو المقاومة للصدمات، وأبواب المرآب المعززة، والمزاريب الصالحة من المخاطر. اسأل شركة التأمين الخاصة بك عن التحسينات التي تمنح خصومات.

segments.src: - **Add protective devices.** Water leak sensors, automatic shutoff valves, monitored alarms, and smoke detectors may qualify for credits.
segments.tr: - **أضف أجهزة وقائية.** قد تكون أجهزة استشعار تسرب المياه، وصمامات الإغلاق التلقائي، والإنذارات المراقبة، وأجهزة كشف الدخان مؤهلة للحصول على أرصدة.

segments.src: - **Bundle thoughtfully.** Combining home and auto coverage often brings a discount, but compare the bundled price against separate policies.
segments.tr: - **اجمع بعناية.** غالباً ما يجلب دمج تغطية المنزل والسيارات خصماً، ولكن قارن السعر المجمع ضد الوثائق المنفصلة.

segments.src: - **Keep your records clean.** Document your home with photos and a home inventory. It speeds claims and helps ensure you are paid fairly.
segments.tr: - **حافظ على نظافة سجلاتك.** وثّق منزلك بالصور وجرد المنزل. فهو يسرع المطالبات ويساعد في ضمان حصولك على أجر عادل.

segments.src: - **Ask about your options if you are non-renewed.** Contact your state insurance department, which can explain local choices and consumer protections.
segments.tr: - **اسأل عن خياراتك إذا لم يتم تجديدك.** اتصل بقسم التأمين في ولايتك، والذي يمكنه شرح الخيارات المحلية وحماية المستهلك.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## الصورة الأكبر

segments.src: Policymakers are debating how to respond.
segments.tr: يناقش صانعو السياسات كيفية الاستجابة.

segments.src: Proposals include strengthening building codes, funding programs that help owners harden their homes, reforming how states regulate rates, and improving the financial stability of state insurance pools.
segments.tr: تشمل المقترحات تعزيز رموز البناء، وبرامج التمويل التي تساعد المالكين على تقوية منازلهم، وإصلاح كيفية تنظيم الولايات للأسعار، وتحسين الاستقرار المالي لمجمعات التأمين الحكومية.

segments.src: Each option involves trade-offs between affordability, insurer solvency, and consumer protection, and no single fix is expected to bring premiums back to earlier levels quickly.
