fr.title: Choc tarifaire de l'assurance habitation : pourquoi les primes continuent d'augmenter, même loin des côtes

segments.src: Opening a homeowners insurance renewal notice has become an anxious moment for many households.
segments.tr: Ouvrir son avis de renouvellement d'assurance habitation est devenu un moment d'anxiété pour de nombreux ménages.

segments.src: Across the country, policyholders are reporting increases of ten percent or more, and in some cases much higher, even when they have never filed a claim and live hundreds of miles from a hurricane zone.
segments.tr: Dans tout le pays, des assurés font état d'augmentations de dix pour cent ou plus, et parfois bien plus encore, même lorsqu'ils n'ont jamais déclaré de sinistre et vivent à des centaines de kilomètres d'une zone cyclonique.

segments.src: The trend is no longer a coastal story.
segments.tr: Cette tendance n'est plus réservée aux zones côtières.

segments.src: It is a national one.
segments.tr: C'est un phénomène national.

segments.src: This article explains the main forces behind rising premiums, why they reach inland communities, and what homeowners can realistically do about it.
segments.tr: Cet article explique les principales causes de la hausse des primes, les raisons pour lesquelles elle touche les collectivités de l'intérieur des terres et ce que les propriétaires peuvent réaliser concrètement.

segments.src: It is general information, not personal financial or insurance advice.
segments.tr: Il s'agit d'informations générales et non de conseils financiers ou d'assurance personnalisés.

segments.src: ## Why a Quiet Neighborhood Still Pays More
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi un quartier calme paye tout de même plus cher

segments.src: Insurance works by pooling risk.
segments.tr: L'assurance fonctionne par mutualisation des risques.

segments.src: Premiums collected from many households fund the claims of the few who suffer losses.
segments.tr: Les primes perçues auprès de nombreux ménages financent les demandes d'indemnisation du petit nombre de ceux qui subissent des pertes.

segments.src: When losses climb in one part of the country, the cost does not stay there.
segments.tr: Lorsque les sinistres augmentent dans une région du pays, le coût ne reste pas cantonné à cet endroit.

segments.src: Insurers price on the basis of their overall results, and the companies that cover your home often operate in dozens of states.
segments.tr: Les assureurs fixent leurs prix en fonction de leurs résultats globaux, et les compagnies qui couvrent votre logement opèrent souvent dans des dizaines d'États.

segments.src: A bad year in one region can lead to rate filings in many others.
segments.tr: Une mauvaise année dans une région peut entraîner des demandes de revalorisation tarifaire dans beaucoup d'autres.

segments.src: Several forces are working at once.
segments.tr: Plusieurs facteurs agissent simultanément.

segments.src: ### 1. The cost of rebuilding has gone up
segments.tr: ### 1. Le coût de reconstruction a augmenté

segments.src: Homeowners insurance is designed to pay to repair or rebuild a home.
segments.tr: L'assurance habitation est conçue pour payer la réparation ou la reconstruction d'un logement.

segments.src: Over the past several years, the prices of lumber, roofing materials, electrical components, and skilled labor have risen significantly compared with earlier in the decade.
segments.tr: Au cours des dernières années, les prix du bois de charpente, des matériaux de couverture, des composants électriques et de la main-d'œuvre qualifiée ont nettement augmenté par rapport au début de la décennie.

segments.src: A policy that adequately covered a house a few years ago may now fall short, so insurers adjust coverage limits upward, and premiums rise with them.
segments.tr: Un contrat qui couvrait adéquatement une maison il y a quelques années peut aujourd'hui s'avérer insuffisant ; les assureurs réajustent donc les plafonds de garantie à la hausse, et les primes augmentent en conséquence.

segments.src: Even a small claim costs more to settle than it used to.
segments.tr: Même la résolution d'un petit sinistre coûte plus cher qu'auparavant.

segments.src: Replacing a roof, repairing water damage, or restoring a kitchen takes more money and, in many places, more time because contractors are in short supply.
segments.tr: Remplacer un toit, réparer un dégât des eaux ou remettre en état une cuisine nécessite plus d'argent et, dans de nombreux endroits, plus de temps en raison de la pénurie d'entrepreneurs.

segments.src: ### 2. Reinsurance has become more expensive
segments.tr: ### 2. La réassurance est devenue plus coûteuse

segments.src: Insurers buy their own insurance, called reinsurance, to protect themselves against very large events.
segments.tr: Les assureurs souscrivent leur propre assurance, appelée réassurance, pour se protéger contre les événements de très grande ampleur.

segments.src: Reinsurers have repriced that protection after several years of heavy catastrophe losses worldwide.
segments.tr: Les réassureurs ont réévalué le prix de cette protection après plusieurs années de lourdes pertes liées à des catastrophes dans le monde entier.

segments.src: When an insurer pays more for reinsurance, that expense is typically reflected in the rates it asks regulators to approve.
segments.tr: Lorsqu'un assureur paie sa réassurance plus cher, cette dépense se répercute généralement sur les tarifs qu'il soumet à l'approbation des régulateurs.

segments.src: Homeowners in a state that has never seen a major hurricane can therefore feel the effects of storms elsewhere.
segments.tr: Les propriétaires situés dans un État qui n'a jamais connu d'ouragan majeur peuvent donc ressentir les effets de tempêtes survenues ailleurs.

segments.src: ### 3. Severe weather is not just a coastal problem
segments.tr: ### 3. Les intempéries ne sont pas qu'un problème côtier

segments.src: Hurricanes get the headlines, but a large share of insured losses in recent years has come from other perils: hail, tornadoes, straight-line winds, wildfire, and winter storms.
segments.tr: Les ouragans font la une des journaux, mais une grande part des pertes assurées ces dernières années provient d'autres périls : grêle, tornades, vents violents, feux de forêt et tempêtes hivernales.

segments.src: Many of these events strike the middle of the country and the interior West.
segments.tr: Beaucoup de ces événements frappent le centre du pays et l'intérieur de l'Ouest.

segments.src: Hail in particular can lead to a wave of roof claims across a metro area in a single afternoon.
segments.tr: La grêle en particulier peut engendrer une vague de réclamations pour les toitures dans toute une zone métropolitaine en un seul après-midi.

segments.src: As these so-called secondary perils have become a bigger part of insurers' loss totals, rate increases have spread to regions that once considered themselves low-risk.
segments.tr: Ces périls dits secondaires occupant une part plus importante dans le total des pertes des assureurs, les hausses de tarifs se sont étendues à des régions qui se considéraient autrefois comme à faible risque.

segments.src: ### 4. Inflation and legal costs add pressure
segments.tr: ### 4. L'inflation et les frais de justice accentuent la pression

segments.src: General price increases affect every part of a claim, from materials to adjusters to vehicle and equipment costs.
segments.tr: La hausse générale des prix touche chaque élément d'une demande d'indemnisation, des matériaux aux experts, en passant par le coût des véhicules et des équipements.

segments.src: In some states, litigation around claims has also added to insurers' expenses.
segments.tr: Dans certains États, les contentieux liés aux sinistres ont également alourdi les dépenses des assureurs.

segments.src: Where legal costs are high, insurers say they must build that into pricing.
segments.tr: Là où les frais de justice sont élevés, les assureurs affirment devoir les intégrer dans leurs tarifs.

segments.src: Consumer advocates, for their part, note that disputes often arise when claims are delayed or underpaid.
segments.tr: Les associations de défense des consommateurs soulignent de leur côté que des différends surviennent souvent lorsque le paiement des indemnités est retardé ou sous-évalué.

segments.src: Both sides agree on one point: costs are rising.
segments.tr: Les deux parties s'accordent sur un point : les coûts augmentent.

segments.src: ## When Insurers Pull Back
segments.tr: ## Quand les assureurs se désengagent

segments.src: For some homeowners the problem is not only price but availability.
segments.tr: Pour certains propriétaires, le problème n'est pas seulement le prix, mais la disponibilité de l'offre.

segments.src: A number of insurers have stopped writing new policies in certain states, restricted new business in high-risk areas, or declined to renew existing policies.
segments.tr: Un certain nombre d'assureurs ont cessé de souscrire de nouveaux contrats dans certains États, ont restreint les nouvelles affaires dans les zones à haut risque ou ont refusé de renouveler les contrats existants.

segments.src: Reasons include repeated losses, difficulty getting rate increases approved quickly, and concerns about the age or condition of roofs.
segments.tr: Les raisons invoquées incluent la répétition des sinistres, la difficulté d'obtenir rapidement l'approbation des hausses de tarifs et les inquiétudes concernant l'âge ou l'état des toitures.

segments.src: When private coverage shrinks, more people turn to state-backed insurers of last resort, often called FAIR Plans or similar programs.
segments.tr: Lorsque la couverture privée se réduit, davantage de personnes se tournent vers les assureurs de dernier recours soutenu par l'État, souvent appelés plans FAIR ou programmes similaires.

segments.src: These plans generally offer more limited coverage and can cost more.
segments.tr: Ces plans offrent généralement une couverture plus limitée et peuvent coûter plus cher.

segments.src: Their growth is itself a warning sign, because a large pool of high-risk policies concentrated in one program can strain the system.
segments.tr: Leur croissance constitue en soi un signal d'alarme, car un vaste ensemble de contrats à haut risque concentré dans un seul programme peut mettre à rude épreuve le système.

segments.src: Mortgage lenders require coverage, so a lapse is not an option for most owners.
segments.tr: Les organismes de prêt hypothécaire exigeant une couverture, une interruption d'assurance n'est pas une option pour la plupart des propriétaires.

segments.src: That gives homeowners little room to walk away from a high quote, which is part of why the issue feels so pressing.
segments.tr: Cela laisse peu de marge de manœuvre aux propriétaires pour refuser un devis élevé, ce qui explique en partie pourquoi la question paraît si urgente.

segments.src: ## What Homeowners Can Do
segments.tr: ## Ce que les propriétaires peuvent faire

segments.src: There is no way to avoid market-wide trends, but there are practical steps that may help limit the damage.
segments.tr: Il n'y a pas de moyen d'échapper aux tendances globales du marché, mais il existe des mesures pratiques qui peuvent aider à limiter les dégâts.

segments.src: - **Shop around every year.** Quotes for the same house can differ widely between companies. An independent agent can compare several carriers at once.
segments.tr: - **Faites jouer la concurrence chaque année.** Les devis pour une même maison peuvent varier considérablement d'une compagnie à l'autre. Un agent indépendant peut comparer plusieurs assureurs à la fois.

segments.src: - **Review your coverage, not just the price.** Make sure your dwelling limit reflects current rebuilding costs. Cutting coverage too far to save money can leave a gap after a loss.
segments.tr: - **Examinez votre couverture, pas seulement le prix.** Assurez-vous que la limite de garantie de votre logement reflète les coûts actuels de reconstruction. Réduire à l'excès sa couverture pour économiser de l'argent peut laisser un reste à charge important après un sinistre.

segments.src: - **Raise your deductible carefully.** A higher deductible usually lowers the premium, but only choose an amount you could pay from savings. Note that many policies now carry a separate, higher deductible for wind or hail.
segments.tr: - **Augmentez votre franchise avec précaution.** Une franchise plus élevée réduit généralement la prime, mais ne choisissez qu'un montant que vous pourriez payer grâce à votre épargne. Notez que de nombreux contrats comportent désormais une franchise séparée et plus élevée pour le vent ou la grêle.

segments.src: - **Invest in your roof.** Newer or impact-resistant roofing, reinforced garage doors, and properly maintained gutters can reduce risk. Ask your insurer which improvements earn discounts.
segments.tr: - **Investissez dans votre toiture.** Une couverture récente ou résistante aux impacts, des portes de garage renforcées et des gouttières bien entretenues peuvent réduire le risque. Demandez à votre assureur quelles améliorations donnent droit à des réductions.

segments.src: - **Add protective devices.** Water leak sensors, automatic shutoff valves, monitored alarms, and smoke detectors may qualify for credits.
segments.tr: - **Ajoutez des dispositifs de protection.** Les détecteurs de fuites d'eau, les vannes d'arrêt automatique, les alarmes télésurveillées et les détecteurs de fumée peuvent vous rendre éligible à des réductions de prime.

segments.src: - **Bundle thoughtfully.** Combining home and auto coverage often brings a discount, but compare the bundled price against separate policies.
segments.tr: - **Regroupez vos contrats de manière judicieuse.** Combiner l'assurance habitation et l'assurance auto donne souvent droit à une remise, mais comparez le prix regroupé avec des contrats séparés.

segments.src: - **Keep your records clean.** Document your home with photos and a home inventory. It speeds claims and helps ensure you are paid fairly.
segments.tr: - **Conservez des dossiers précis.** Documentez votre logement au moyen de photos et d'un inventaire de vos biens. Cela accélère le règlement des sinistres et permet de vous assurer une indemnisation équitable.

segments.src: - **Ask about your options if you are non-renewed.** Contact your state insurance department, which can explain local choices and consumer protections.
segments.tr: - **Renseignez-vous sur vos options en cas de non-renouvellement.** Contactez le service des assurances de votre État, qui pourra vous expliquer les possibilités locales et les protections des consommateurs.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## Une vue d'ensemble

segments.src: Policymakers are debating how to respond.
segments.tr: Les décideurs politiques débattent de la réponse à apporter.

segments.src: Proposals include strengthening building codes, funding programs that help owners harden their homes, reforming how states regulate rates, and improving the financial stability of state insurance pools.
segments.tr: Les propositions incluent le renforcement des normes de construction, le financement de programmes aidant les propriétaires à consolider leur logement, la réforme de la réglementation des tarifs par les États et l'amélioration de la stabilité financière des pools d'assurance d'État.

segments.src: Each option involves trade-offs between affordability, insurer solvency, and consumer protection, and no single fix is expected to bring premiums back to earlier levels quickly.
segments.tr: Chaque option implique des arbitrages entre l'accessibilité financière, la solvabilité des assureurs et la protection des consommateurs, et aucune solution unique ne devrait ramener rapidement les primes aux niveaux antérieurs.

segments.src: For now, the practical takeaway is that home insurance is increasingly a cost to be managed actively rather than a bill to be paid on autopilot.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, la leçon pratique à en tirer est que l'assurance habitation est de plus en plus un coût à gérer de façon active plutôt qu'une facture à payer en pilote automatique.

segments.src: Reviewing your policy each year, understanding what it covers, and reducing your home's risk are the most reliable tools homeowners have, whether they live on the coast or hundreds of miles inland.
segments.tr: Réexaminer votre contrat chaque année, comprendre ce qu'il couvre et réduire les risques de votre logement sont les outils les plus fiables dont disposent les propriétaires, qu'ils vivent sur la côte ou à des centaines de kilomètres à l'intérieur des terres.

segments.tr: *Cet article est destiné à des fins d'information générale uniquement et ne constitue pas un conseil en matière d'assurance, juridique ou financier.

segments.src: Coverage terms and prices vary by insurer and state; consult a licensed agent or your state insurance department for guidance specific to your situation.*
segments.tr: Les conditions de couverture et les prix varient selon l'assureur et l'État ; consultez un agent agréé ou le service des assurances de votre État pour obtenir des conseils adaptés à votre situation.*

segments.tr: Quando a cobertura privada encolhe, mais pessoas recorrem a seguradoras estatais de último recurso, frequentemente chamadas de Planos FAIR ou programas similares.

segments.src: These plans generally offer more limited coverage and can cost more.
segments.tr: Esses planos geralmente oferecem cobertura mais limitada e podem custar mais.

segments.src: Their growth is itself a warning sign, because a large pool of high-risk policies concentrated in one program can strain the system.
segments.tr: O crescimento deles é, por si só, um sinal de alerta, porque um grande grupo de apólices de alto risco concentradas em um único programa pode sobrecarregar o sistema.

segments.src: Mortgage lenders require coverage, so a lapse is not an option for most owners.
segments.tr: Os credores hipotecários exigem cobertura, portanto, uma interrupção não é uma opção para a maioria dos proprietários.

segments.src: That gives homeowners little room to walk away from a high quote, which is part of why the issue feels so pressing.
segments.tr: Isso dá aos proprietários pouca margem para recusar uma cotação alta, o que é parte do motivo pelo qual o problema parece tão urgente.

segments.src: ## What Homeowners Can Do
segments.tr: ## O Que os Proprietários Podem Fazer

segments.src: There is no way to avoid market-wide trends, but there are practical steps that may help limit the damage.
segments.tr: Não há como evitar as tendências de mercado, mas há etapas práticas que podem ajudar a limitar os danos.

segments.src: - **Shop around every year.** Quotes for the same house can differ widely between companies. An independent agent can compare several carriers at once.
segments.tr: - **Pesquise preços todos os anos.** As cotações para a mesma casa podem variar muito entre as empresas. Um corretor independente pode comparar várias seguradoras de uma só vez.

segments.src: - **Review your coverage, not just the price.** Make sure your dwelling limit reflects current rebuilding costs. Cutting coverage too far to save money can leave a gap after a loss.
segments.tr: - **Revise sua cobertura, não apenas o preço.** Certifique-se de que o limite da sua residência reflita os custos atuais de reconstrução. Reduzir demais a cobertura para economizar dinheiro pode deixar uma lacuna após um sinistro.

segments.src: - **Raise your deductible carefully.** A higher deductible usually lowers the premium, but only choose an amount you could pay from savings. Note that many policies now carry a separate, higher deductible for wind or hail.
segments.tr: - **Aumente sua franquia com cuidado.** Uma franquia mais alta geralmente reduz o prêmio, mas escolha apenas um valor que você possa pagar com suas economias. Observe que muitas apólices agora trazem uma franquia separada e mais alta para ventos ou granizo.

segments.src: - **Invest in your roof.** Newer or impact-resistant roofing, reinforced garage doors, and properly maintained gutters can reduce risk. Ask your insurer which improvements earn discounts.
segments.tr: - **Invista no seu telhado.** Coberturas mais novas ou resistentes a impactos, portas de garagem reforçadas e calhas devidamente mantidas podem reduzir o risco. Pergunte à sua seguradora quais melhorias geram descontos.

segments.src: - **Add protective devices.** Water leak sensors, automatic shutoff valves, monitored alarms, and smoke detectors may qualify for credits.
segments.tr: - **Adicione dispositivos de proteção.** Sensores de vazamento de água, válvulas de fechamento automático, alarmes monitorados e detectores de fumaça podem se qualificar para créditos.

segments.src: - **Bundle thoughtfully.** Combining home and auto coverage often brings a discount, but compare the bundled price against separate policies.
segments.tr: - **Agrupe com cuidado.** Combinar cobertura residencial e de automóveis geralmente traz um desconto, mas compare o preço agrupado com apólices separadas.

segments.src: - **Keep your records clean.** Document your home with photos and a home inventory. It speeds claims and helps ensure you are paid fairly.
segments.tr: - **Mantenha seus registros limpos.** Documente sua casa com fotos e um inventário residencial. Isso acelera os sinistros e ajuda a garantir que você receba um valor justo.

segments.src: - **Ask about your options if you are non-renewed.** Contact your state insurance department, which can explain local choices and consumer protections.
segments.tr: - **Pergunte sobre suas opções caso sua apólice não seja renovada.** Entre em contato com o departamento de seguros do seu estado, que pode explicar as opções locais e as proteções ao consumidor.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## O Panorama Geral

segments.src: Policymakers are debating how to respond.
segments.tr: Os formuladores de políticas estão debatendo como responder.

segments.src: Proposals include strengthening building codes, funding programs that help owners harden their homes, reforming how states regulate rates, and improving the financial stability of state insurance pools.
segments.tr: As propostas incluem o fortalecimento de códigos de construção, financiamento de programas que ajudem os proprietários a proteger suas residências, reforma na forma como os estados regulam as tarifas e melhoria da estabilidade financeira dos fundos de seguro estaduais.

segments.src: Each option involves trade-offs between affordability, insurer solvency, and consumer protection, and no single fix is expected to bring premiums back to earlier levels quickly.
segments.tr: Cada opção envolve concessões entre acessibilidade, solvência da seguradora e proteção ao consumidor, e não se espera que nenhuma solução isolada traga os prêmios de volta aos níveis anteriores rapidamente.

segments.src: For now, the practical takeaway is that home insurance is increasingly a cost to be managed actively rather than a bill to be paid on autopilot.
segments.tr: Por enquanto, a conclusão prática é que o seguro residencial é cada vez mais um custo a ser gerenciado ativamente, em vez de uma conta a ser paga no piloto automático.

segments.src: Reviewing your policy each year, understanding what it covers, and reducing your home's risk are the most reliable tools homeowners have, whether they live on the coast or hundreds of miles inland.
segments.tr: Revisar sua apólice todos os anos, entender o que ela cobre e reduzir o risco de sua casa são as ferramentas mais confiáveis que os proprietários têm, quer vivam no litoral ou a centenas de quilômetros no interior.

in.title: Kenaikan Premi Asuransi Rumah: Mengapa Premi Terus Naik, Bahkan Jauh dari Pantai

segments.src: Opening a homeowners insurance renewal notice has become an anxious moment for many households.
segments.tr: Membuka pemberitahuan pembaruan asuransi pemilik rumah telah menjadi saat yang mencemaskan bagi banyak keluarga.

segments.src: Across the country, policyholders are reporting increases of ten percent or more, and in some cases much higher, even when they have never filed a claim and live hundreds of miles from a hurricane zone.
segments.tr: Di seluruh negeri, pemegang polis melaporkan kenaikan sepuluh persen atau lebih, dan dalam beberapa kasus jauh lebih tinggi, bahkan ketika mereka tidak pernah mengajukan klaim dan tinggal ratusan mil dari zona badai.

segments.src: The trend is no longer a coastal story.
segments.tr: Tren ini bukan lagi cerita tentang wilayah pesisir.

segments.src: It is a national one.
segments.tr: Ini adalah masalah nasional.

segments.src: This article explains the main forces behind rising premiums, why they reach inland communities, and what homeowners can realistically do about it.
segments.tr: Artikel ini menjelaskan kekuatan utama di balik kenaikan premi, mengapa hal itu menjangkau komunitas pedalaman, dan apa yang dapat dilakukan oleh pemilik rumah secara realistis.

segments.src: It is general information, not personal financial or insurance advice.
segments.tr: Ini adalah informasi umum, bukan nasihat keuangan atau asuransi pribadi.

segments.src: ## Why a Quiet Neighborhood Still Pays More
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Lingkungan yang Tenang Tetap Membayar Lebih

segments.src: Insurance works by pooling risk.
segments.tr: Asuransi bekerja dengan mengumpulkan risiko.

segments.src: Premiums collected from many households fund the claims of the few who suffer losses.
segments.tr: Premi yang dikumpulkan dari banyak rumah tangga mendanai klaim dari segelintir orang yang menderita kerugian.

segments.src: When losses climb in one part of the country, the cost does not stay there.
segments.tr: Ketika kerugian meningkat di satu bagian negara, biayanya tidak berhenti di situ.

segments.src: Insurers price on the basis of their overall results, and the companies that cover your home often operate in dozens of states.
segments.tr: Perusahaan asuransi menetapkan harga berdasarkan hasil keseluruhan mereka, dan perusahaan yang melindungi rumah Anda sering kali beroperasi di puluhan negara bagian.

segments.src: A bad year in one region can lead to rate filings in many others.
segments.tr: Tahun yang buruk di satu wilayah dapat menyebabkan pengajuan tarif di banyak wilayah lainnya.

segments.src: Several forces are working at once.
segments.tr: Beberapa kekuatan bekerja sekaligus.

segments.src: ### 1. The cost of rebuilding has gone up
segments.tr: ### 1. Biaya pembangunan kembali telah meningkat

segments.src: Homeowners insurance is designed to pay to repair or rebuild a home.
segments.tr: Asuransi pemilik rumah dirancang untuk membayar perbaikan atau pembangunan kembali rumah.

segments.src: Over the past several years, the prices of lumber, roofing materials, electrical components, and skilled labor have risen significantly compared with earlier in the decade.
segments.tr: Selama beberapa tahun terakhir, harga kayu, bahan atap, komponen kelistrikan, dan tenaga kerja terampil telah meningkat secara signifikan dibandingkan dengan awal dekade ini.

segments.src: A policy that adequately covered a house a few years ago may now fall short, so insurers adjust coverage limits upward, and premiums rise with them.
segments.tr: Polis yang mencakup rumah secara memadai beberapa tahun lalu mungkin sekarang kurang, sehingga perusahaan asuransi menyesuaikan batas pertanggungan ke atas, dan premi naik bersamanya.

segments.src: Even a small claim costs more to settle than it used to.
segments.tr: Bahkan klaim kecil pun membutuhkan biaya lebih untuk diselesaikan daripada sebelumnya.

segments.src: Replacing a roof, repairing water damage, or restoring a kitchen takes more money and, in many places, more time because contractors are in short supply.
segments.tr: Mengganti atap, memperbaiki kerusakan air, atau memulihkan dapur membutuhkan lebih banyak uang dan, di banyak tempat, lebih banyak waktu karena kontraktor langka.

segments.src: ### 2. Reinsurance has become more expensive
segments.tr: ### 2. Reasuransi menjadi lebih mahal

segments.src: Insurers buy their own insurance, called reinsurance, to protect themselves against very large events.
segments.tr: Perusahaan asuransi membeli asuransi mereka sendiri, yang disebut reasuransi, untuk melindungi diri mereka dari peristiwa yang sangat besar.

segments.src: Reinsurers have repriced that protection after several years of heavy catastrophe losses worldwide.
segments.tr: Reasuradur telah menetapkan harga ulang perlindungan tersebut setelah beberapa tahun mengalami kerugian bencana yang berat di seluruh dunia.

segments.src: When an insurer pays more for reinsurance, that expense is typically reflected in the rates it asks regulators to approve.
segments.tr: Ketika perusahaan asuransi membayar lebih untuk reasuransi, biaya tersebut biasanya tercermin dalam tarif yang diminta untuk disetujui oleh regulator.

segments.src: Homeowners in a state that has never seen a major hurricane can therefore feel the effects of storms elsewhere.
segments.tr: Oleh karena itu, pemilik rumah di negara bagian yang tidak pernah mengalami badai besar dapat merasakan efek badai di tempat lain.

segments.src: ### 3. Severe weather is not just a coastal problem
segments.tr: ### 3. Cuaca ekstrem bukan hanya masalah pesisir

segments.src: Hurricanes get the headlines, but a large share of insured losses in recent years has come from other perils: hail, tornadoes, straight-line winds, wildfire, and winter storms.
segments.tr: Badai mendominasi berita utama, tetapi sebagian besar kerugian yang diasuransikan dalam beberapa tahun terakhir berasal dari bahaya lain: hujan es, angin puting beliung, angin kencang, kebakaran hutan, dan badai musim dingin.

segments.src: Many of these events strike the middle of the country and the interior West.
segments.tr: Banyak dari peristiwa ini melanda bagian tengah negara dan bagian dalam Barat.

segments.src: Hail in particular can lead to a wave of roof claims across a metro area in a single afternoon.
segments.tr: Hujan es khususnya dapat menyebabkan gelombang klaim atap di seluruh wilayah metropolitan dalam satu sore.

segments.src: As these so-called secondary perils have become a bigger part of insurers' loss totals, rate increases have spread to regions that once considered themselves low-risk.
segments.tr: Karena apa yang disebut bahaya sekunder ini telah menjadi bagian yang lebih besar dari total kerugian perusahaan asuransi, kenaikan tarif telah menyebar ke wilayah yang dulunya menganggap diri mereka berisiko rendah.

segments.src: ### 4. Inflation and legal costs add pressure
segments.tr: ### 4. Inflasi dan biaya hukum menambah tekanan

segments.src: General price increases affect every part of a claim, from materials to adjusters to vehicle and equipment costs.
segments.tr: Kenaikan harga secara umum mempengaruhi setiap bagian klaim, mulai dari bahan hingga penyesuai klaim hingga biaya kendaraan dan peralatan.

segments.src: In some states, litigation around claims has also added to insurers' expenses.
segments.tr: Di beberapa negara bagian, litigasi seputar klaim juga menambah pengeluaran perusahaan asuransi.

segments.src: Where legal costs are high, insurers say they must build that into pricing.
segments.tr: Di mana biaya hukum tinggi, perusahaan asuransi mengatakan mereka harus memasukkannya ke dalam penetapan harga.

segments.src: Consumer advocates, for their part, note that disputes often arise when claims are delayed or underpaid.
segments.tr: Para advokat konsumen, pada bagian mereka, mencatat bahwa perselisihan sering timbul ketika klaim ditunda atau dibayar kurang.

segments.src: Both sides agree on one point: costs are rising.
segments.tr: Kedua belah pihak menyetujui satu poin: biaya terus meningkat.

segments.src: ## When Insurers Pull Back
segments.tr: ## Ketika Perusahaan Asuransi Menarik Diri

segments.src: For some homeowners the problem is not only price but availability.
segments.tr: Bagi sebagian pemilik rumah, masalahnya bukan hanya harga tetapi ketersediaan.

segments.src: A number of insurers have stopped writing new policies in certain states, restricted new business in high-risk areas, or declined to renew existing policies.
segments.tr: Sejumlah perusahaan asuransi telah berhenti menulis polis baru di negara bagian tertentu, membatasi bisnis baru di daerah berisiko tinggi, atau menolak untuk memperbarui polis yang ada.

segments.src: Reasons include repeated losses, difficulty getting rate increases approved quickly, and concerns about the age or condition of roofs.
segments.tr: Alasannya termasuk kerugian berulang, kesulitan mendapatkan persetujuan kenaikan tarif dengan cepat, dan kekhawatiran tentang usia atau kondisi atap.

segments.src: When private coverage shrinks, more people turn to state-backed insurers of last resort, often called FAIR Plans or similar programs.
segments.tr: Ketika pertanggungan swasta menyusut, lebih banyak orang beralih ke perusahaan asuransi pilihan terakhir yang didukung negara, sering disebut Rencana FAIR atau program serupa.

segments.src: These plans generally offer more limited coverage and can cost more.
segments.tr: Rencana ini umumnya menawarkan pertanggungan yang lebih terbatas dan biayanya bisa lebih mahal.

segments.src: Their growth is itself a warning sign, because a large pool of high-risk policies concentrated in one program can strain the system.
segments.tr: Pertumbuhan mereka sendiri merupakan tanda peringatan, karena kumpulan besar polis berisiko tinggi yang terkonsentrasi dalam satu program dapat membebani sistem.

segments.src: Mortgage lenders require coverage, so a lapse is not an option for most owners.
segments.tr: Pemberi pinjaman hipotek memerlukan pertanggungan, jadi kelalaian bukanlah pilihan bagi sebagian besar pemilik.

segments.src: That gives homeowners little room to walk away from a high quote, which is part of why the issue feels so pressing.
segments.tr: Hal itu memberi pemilik rumah sedikit ruang untuk meninggalkan penawaran tinggi, yang merupakan bagian dari alasan mengapa masalah ini terasa begitu mendesak.

segments.src: ## What Homeowners Can Do
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Dapat Dilakukan Pemilik Rumah

segments.src: There is no way to avoid market-wide trends, but there are practical steps that may help limit the damage.
segments.tr: Tidak ada cara untuk menghindari tren seluruh pasar, tetapi ada langkah-langkah praktis yang dapat membantu membatasi kerusakan.

segments.src: - **Shop around every year.** Quotes for the same house can differ widely between companies. An independent agent can compare several carriers at once.
segments.tr: - **Berbelanja dan bandingkan setiap tahun.** Penawaran untuk rumah yang sama dapat sangat berbeda antar perusahaan. Agen independen dapat membandingkan beberapa perusahaan sekaligus.

segments.src: - **Review your coverage, not just the price.** Make sure your dwelling limit reflects current rebuilding costs. Cutting coverage too far to save money can leave a gap after a loss.
segments.tr: - **Tinjau pertanggungan Anda, bukan hanya harganya.** Pastikan batas hunian Anda mencerminkan biaya pembangunan kembali saat ini. Memotong pertanggungan terlalu jauh untuk menghemat uang dapat meninggalkan celah setelah kerugian.

segments.src: - **Raise your deductible carefully.** A higher deductible usually lowers the premium, but only choose an amount you could pay from savings. Note that many policies now carry a separate, higher deductible for wind or hail.
segments.tr: - **Tingkatkan denda tanggungan Anda dengan hati-hati.** Pengurang yang lebih tinggi biasanya menurunkan premi, tetapi hanya pilih jumlah yang dapat Anda bayar dari tabungan. Perhatikan bahwa banyak polis sekarang membawa pengurang yang terpisah dan lebih tinggi untuk angin atau hujan es.

segments.src: - **Invest in your roof.** Newer or impact-resistant roofing, reinforced garage doors, and properly maintained gutters can reduce risk. Ask your insurer which improvements earn discounts.
segments.tr: - **Berinvestasi di atap Anda.** Atap yang lebih baru atau tahan benturan, pintu garasi yang diperkuat, dan selokan yang dirawat dengan baik dapat mengurangi risiko. Tanyakan kepada perusahaan asuransi Anda perbaikan mana yang mendapat diskon.

segments.src: - **Add protective devices.** Water leak sensors, automatic shutoff valves, monitored alarms, and smoke detectors may qualify for credits.
segments.tr: - **Tambahkan perangkat pelindung.** Sensor kebocoran air, katup penutup otomatis, alarm yang dipantau, dan detektor asap mungkin memenuhi syarat untuk kredit.

segments.src: - **Bundle thoughtfully.** Combining home and auto coverage often brings a discount, but compare the bundled price against separate policies.
segments.tr: - **Gabungkan dengan bijak.** Menggabungkan perlindungan rumah dan mobil seringkali memberikan diskon, tetapi bandingkan harga gabungan dengan polis terpisah.

segments.src: - **Keep your records clean.** Document your home with photos and a home inventory. It speeds claims and helps ensure you are paid fairly.
segments.tr: - **Jaga catatan Anda tetap bersih.** Dokumentasikan rumah Anda dengan foto dan inventaris rumah. Ini mempercepat klaim dan membantu memastikan Anda dibayar secara adil.

segments.src: - **Ask about your options if you are non-renewed.** Contact your state insurance department, which can explain local choices and consumer protections.
segments.tr: - **Tanyakan tentang opsi Anda jika Anda tidak diperbarui.** Hubungi departemen asuransi negara bagian Anda, yang dapat menjelaskan pilihan lokal dan perlindungan konsumen.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## Gambaran yang Lebih Besar

segments.src: Policymakers are debating how to respond.
segments.tr: Pembuat kebijakan sedang memperdebatkan bagaimana merespons.

segments.src: Proposals include strengthening building codes, funding programs that help owners harden their homes, reforming how states regulate rates, and improving the financial stability of state insurance pools.
segments.tr: Usulannya meliputi memperkuat kode bangunan, mendanai program yang membantu pemilik memperkuat rumah mereka, mereformasi bagaimana negara bagian mengatur tarif, dan meningkatkan stabilitas keuangan kumpulan asuransi negara bagian.

segments.src: Each option involves trade-offs between affordability, insurer solvency, and consumer protection, and no single fix is expected to bring premiums back to earlier levels quickly.
segments.tr: Setiap opsi melibatkan pertukaran antara keterjangkauan, solvabilitas penanggung, dan perlindungan konsumen, dan tidak ada satu perbaikan tunggal yang diharapkan dapat mengembalikan premi ke tingkat sebelumnya dengan cepat.

segments.src: For now, the practical takeaway is that home insurance is increasingly a cost to be managed actively rather than a bill to be paid on autopilot.
segments.tr: Untuk saat ini, kesimpulan praktisnya adalah bahwa asuransi rumah semakin menjadi biaya yang harus dikelola secara aktif daripada tagihan yang harus dibayar secara otomatis.

segments.src: Reviewing your policy each year, understanding what it covers, and reducing your home's risk are the most reliable tools homeowners have, whether they live on the coast or hundreds of miles inland.
segments.tr: Meninjau polis Anda setiap tahun, memahami apa yang dicakupnya, dan mengurangi risiko rumah Anda adalah alat paling andal yang dimiliki pemilik rumah, apakah mereka tinggal di pantai atau ratusan mil di pedalaman.

segments.tr: *Artikel ini hanya untuk tujuan informasi umum dan bukan merupakan nasihat asuransi, hukum, atau keuangan.

segments.src: Coverage terms and prices vary by insurer and state; consult a licensed agent or your state insurance department for guidance specific to your situation.*

segments.src: ### 1. The cost of rebuilding has gone up
segments.tr: ### 1. 再建築コストの上昇

segments.src: Homeowners insurance is designed to pay to repair or rebuild a home.
segments.tr: 火災保険は、住宅の修理や再建の費用を支払うように設計されています。

segments.src: Over the past several years, the prices of lumber, roofing materials, electrical components, and skilled labor have risen significantly compared with earlier in the decade.
segments.tr: ここ数年、木材、屋根材、電気部品、熟練労働者の価格は、この十年の初めと比較して大幅に上昇しています。

segments.src: A policy that adequately covered a house a few years ago may now fall short, so insurers adjust coverage limits upward, and premiums rise with them.
segments.tr: 数年前には家を十分にカバーしていた保険契約も、現在では不足している可能性があり、保険会社は補償限度額を上方修正し、それに応じて保険料も上昇します。

segments.src: Even a small claim costs more to settle than it used to.
segments.tr: 小さな請求であっても、以前より解決にかかる費用が高くなっています。

segments.src: Replacing a roof, repairing water damage, or restoring a kitchen takes more money and, in many places, more time because contractors are in short supply.
segments.tr: 屋根の交換、水害の修理、キッチンの修復にはより多くのお金がかかり、多くの場所では、施工業者が不足しているためにより多くの時間もかかります。

segments.src: ### 2. Reinsurance has become more expensive
segments.tr: ### 2. 再保険の高騰

segments.src: Insurers buy their own insurance, called reinsurance, to protect themselves against very large events.
segments.tr: 保険会社は、非常に大規模な事象から身を守るために、「再保険」と呼ばれる独自の保険に加入しています。

segments.src: Reinsurers have repriced that protection after several years of heavy catastrophe losses worldwide.
segments.tr: 再保険会社は、世界中で数年にわたる多額の災害損失が発生した後、その保護の価格を再設定しました。

segments.src: When an insurer pays more for reinsurance, that expense is typically reflected in the rates it asks regulators to approve.
segments.tr: 保険会社が再保険により多くの費用を支払う場合、その費用は通常、規制当局に承認を求める料率に反映されます。

segments.src: Homeowners in a state that has never seen a major hurricane can therefore feel the effects of storms elsewhere.
segments.tr: したがって、一度も大きなハリケーンに見舞われたことのない州の住宅所有者も、他の場所での嵐の影響を感じることになります。

segments.src: ### 3. Severe weather is not just a coastal problem
segments.tr: ### 3. 悪天候は沿岸部だけの問題ではない

segments.src: Hurricanes get the headlines, but a large share of insured losses in recent years has come from other perils: hail, tornadoes, straight-line winds, wildfire, and winter storms.
segments.tr: ハリケーンがヘッドラインを飾りますが、近年における保険金請求の大部分は、ヒョウ、竜巻、直線風、山火事、冬の嵐などの他の災害によるものです。

segments.src: Many of these events strike the middle of the country and the interior West.
segments.tr: これらの事象の多くは、国の中心部や内陸の西部を直撃します。

segments.src: Hail in particular can lead to a wave of roof claims across a metro area in a single afternoon.
segments.tr: 特にヒョウは、一日のうちに都市圏全体で屋根の請求の波を引き起こす可能性があります。

segments.src: As these so-called secondary perils have become a bigger part of insurers' loss totals, rate increases have spread to regions that once considered themselves low-risk.
segments.tr: いわゆる二次的な災害が保険会社の損失総額のより大きな割合を占めるようになるにつれて、かつては低リスクと考えていた地域にも料率引き上げが広がっています。

segments.src: ### 4. Inflation and legal costs add pressure
segments.tr: ### 4. インフレと法的費用の圧迫

segments.src: General price increases affect every part of a claim, from materials to adjusters to vehicle and equipment costs.
segments.tr: 一般的な価格上昇は、材料からアジャスター、車両や設備のコストに至るまで、請求のあらゆる部分に影響を与えます。

segments.src: In some states, litigation around claims has also added to insurers' expenses.
segments.tr: 一部の州では、請求をめぐる訴訟も保険会社の費用を増加させています。

segments.src: Where legal costs are high, insurers say they must build that into pricing.
segments.tr: 法的費用が高い場所では、保険会社はその費用を価格に反映させなければならないと述べています。

segments.src: Consumer advocates, for their part, note that disputes often arise when claims are delayed or underpaid.
segments.tr: 一方、消費者擁護団体は、請求が遅れたり過少に支払われたりするときに紛争がしばしば発生すると指摘しています。

segments.src: Both sides agree on one point: costs are rising.
segments.tr: 両者は1つの点について意見が一致しています。それはコストが上昇しているということです。

segments.src: ## When Insurers Pull Back
segments.tr: ## 保険会社が撤退するとき

segments.src: For some homeowners the problem is not only price but availability.
segments.tr: 一部の住宅所有者にとっての問題は、価格だけでなく利用可能性です。

segments.src: A number of insurers have stopped writing new policies in certain states, restricted new business in high-risk areas, or declined to renew existing policies.
segments.tr: 多くの保険会社が特定の州での新契約の引き受けを停止したり、高リスク地域での新規ビジネスを制限したり、既存契約の更新を拒否したりしています。

segments.src: Reasons include repeated losses, difficulty getting rate increases approved quickly, and concerns about the age or condition of roofs.
segments.tr: 理由は、繰り返される損失、料率引き上げの迅速な承認取得の難しさ、屋根の年齢や状態に関する懸念などです。

segments.src: When private coverage shrinks, more people turn to state-backed insurers of last resort, often called FAIR Plans or similar programs.
segments.tr: 民間の補償が縮小すると、より多くの人々が、FAIRプランまたは類似のプログラムと呼ばれる、最後の手段としての州支援の保険に頼るようになります。

segments.src: These plans generally offer more limited coverage and can cost more.
segments.tr: これらのプランは一般的に、より制限された補償を提供し、費用が高くなる可能性があります。

segments.src: Their growth is itself a warning sign, because a large pool of high-risk policies concentrated in one program can strain the system.
segments.tr: その成長自体が警告のサインであり、1つのプログラムに集中した高リスクのポリシーの大きなプールはシステムに負担をかける可能性があるためです。

segments.src: Mortgage lenders require coverage, so a lapse is not an option for most owners.
segments.tr: 住宅ローン提供者は補償を求めているため、失効はほとんどの所有者にとって選択肢ではありません。

segments.src: That gives homeowners little room to walk away from a high quote, which is part of why the issue feels so pressing.
segments.tr: そのため、住宅所有者は高い見積もりから離れる余地がほとんどなく、これが問題が非常に差し迫っていると感じられる理由の一部です。

segments.src: ## What Homeowners Can Do
segments.tr: ## 住宅所有者ができること

segments.src: There is no way to avoid market-wide trends, but there are practical steps that may help limit the damage.
segments.tr: 市場全体のトレンドを避ける方法はありませんが、損害を制限するのに役立つ実践的なステップがあります。

segments.src: - **Shop around every year.** Quotes for the same house can differ widely between companies. An independent agent can compare several carriers at once.
segments.tr: - **毎年相見積もりを取る。** 同じ家でも、会社によって見積もりが大きく異なる場合があります。独立系の代理店は、複数のキャリアを一度に比較できます。

segments.src: - **Review your coverage, not just the price.** Make sure your dwelling limit reflects current rebuilding costs. Cutting coverage too far to save money can leave a gap after a loss.
segments.tr: - **価格だけでなく、補償内容も見直す。** 自宅の再建コストをdwellingの制限が反映していることを確認してください。お金を節約するために補償を削りすぎると、損失後にギャップが残る可能性があります。

segments.src: - **Raise your deductible carefully.** A higher deductible usually lowers the premium, but only choose an amount you could pay from savings. Note that many policies now carry a separate, higher deductible for wind or hail.
segments.tr: - **免責金額を慎重に引き上げる。** 免責金額を高くすると通常は保険料が下がりますが、貯蓄から支払える額のみを選択してください。現在、多くのポリシーには、風やヒョウに対する別個のより高い免責金額が設定されていることに注意してください。

segments.src: - **Invest in your roof.** Newer or impact-resistant roofing, reinforced garage doors, and properly maintained gutters can reduce risk. Ask your insurer which improvements earn discounts.
segments.tr: - **屋根に投資する。** より新しい、または耐衝撃性の屋根、補強されたガレージドア、適切にメンテナンスされた雨樋はリスクを軽減できます。どの改善が割引につながるかを保険会社に尋ねてください。

segments.src: - **Add protective devices.** Water leak sensors, automatic shutoff valves, monitored alarms, and smoke detectors may qualify for credits.
segments.tr: - **保護デバイスを追加する。** 水漏れセンサー、自動遮断バルブ、監視付きアラーム、煙感知器はクレジットの対象となる場合があります。

segments.src: - **Bundle thoughtfully.** Combining home and auto coverage often brings a discount, but compare the bundled price against separate policies.
segments.tr: - **上手にバンドルする。** 自宅と自動車の補償を組み合わせることで割引になることが多いですが、バンドルされた価格と個別のポリシーを比較してください。

segments.src: - **Keep your records clean.** Document your home with photos and a home inventory. It speeds claims and helps ensure you are paid fairly.
segments.tr: - **記録をきれいに保つ。** 写真やホームインベントリで自宅を記録します。これにより請求が迅速化され、公正に支払われるようになります。

segments.src: - **Ask about your options if you are non-renewed.** Contact your state insurance department, which can explain local choices and consumer protections.
segments.tr: - **更新されない場合のオプションについて尋ねる。** 地元の選択肢や消費者保護について説明してくれる州の保険部門に連絡してください。

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## より大きな視点

segments.src: Policymakers are debating how to respond.
segments.tr: 政策立案者はどのように対応すべきか議論しています。

segments.src: Proposals include strengthening building codes, funding programs that help owners harden their homes, reforming how states regulate rates, and improving the financial stability of state insurance pools.
segments.tr: 提案には、建築基準法の強化、所有者が自宅を強化するのを支援するプログラムへの資金提供、州の料率規制方法の改革、州の保険プールの財務的安定性の改善が含まれます。

segments.src: Each option involves trade-offs between affordability, insurer solvency, and consumer protection, and no single fix is expected to bring premiums back to earlier levels quickly.
segments.tr: 各オプションには、手頃な価格、保険会社の支払い能力、消費者保護の間のトレードオフが伴い、単一の修正によって保険料が以前の水準にすぐに戻ることは期待されていません。

segments.src: For now, the practical takeaway is that home insurance is increasingly a cost to be managed actively rather than a bill to be paid on autopilot.
segments.tr: 今のところ、実用的な要点として、火災保険は自動操縦で支払う請求書ではなく、積極的に管理すべきコストになりつつあります。

segments.src: Reviewing your policy each year, understanding what it covers, and reducing your home's risk are the most reliable tools homeowners have, whether they live on the coast or hundreds of miles inland.
segments.tr: 毎年ポリシーを見直し、何をカバーしているかを理解し、自宅のリスクを軽減することは、沿岸部に住んでいようと内陸に何百マイル離れて住んでいようと、住宅所有者が持つ最も信頼できるツールです。

segments.tr: *この記事は一般的な情報提供のみを目的としており、保険、法律、または財務上のアドバイスを構成するものではありません。

segments.src: Coverage terms and prices vary by insurer and state; consult a licensed agent or your state insurance department for guidance specific to your situation.*
segments.tr: 補償条件と価格は保険会社と州によって異なります。あなたの状況に合わせたガイダンスについては、ライセンスを持つ代理店または州の保険部門にご相談ください。*

de.title: Schockierende Hausratversicherung: Warum die Prämien weiter steigen, selbst weit entfernt von der Küste

segments.src: Opening a homeowners insurance renewal notice has become an anxious moment for many households.
segments.tr: Das Öffnen einer Erneuerungsmitteilung für die Wohngebäudeversicherung ist für viele Haushalte zu einem Moment der Besorgnis geworden.

segments.src: Across the country, policyholders are reporting increases of ten percent or more, and in some cases much higher, even when they have never filed a claim and live hundreds of miles from a hurricane zone.
segments.tr: Im ganzen Land melden Versicherungsnehmer Erhöhungen von zehn Prozent oder mehr, in einigen Fällen sogar deutlich mehr, selbst wenn sie noch nie einen Schaden gemeldet haben und Hunderte von Meilen von einer Hurrikan-Zone entfernt leben.

segments.src: The trend is no longer a coastal story.
segments.tr: Der Trend ist keine Küstengeschichte mehr.

segments.src: It is a national one.
segments.tr: Es ist eine nationale.

segments.src: This article explains the main forces behind rising premiums, why they reach inland communities, and what homeowners can realistically do about it.
segments.tr: Dieser Artikel erläutert die Hauptgründe für steigernde Prämien, warum sie Binnengemeinden erreichen und was Hausbesitzer realistischerweise dagegen tun können.

segments.src: It is general information, not personal financial or insurance advice.
segments.tr: Es handelt sich um allgemeine Informationen, nicht um persönliche Finanz- oder Versicherungsberatung.

segments.src: ## Why a Quiet Neighborhood Still Pays More
segments.tr: ## Warum eine ruhige Nachbarschaft immer noch mehr bezahlt

segments.src: Insurance works by pooling risk.
segments.tr: Versicherungen funktionieren durch Risikopooling.

segments.src: Premiums collected from many households fund the claims of the few who suffer losses.
segments.tr: Prämien, die von vielen Haushalten erhoben werden, finanzieren die Ansprüche der wenigen, die Verluste erleiden.

segments.src: When losses climb in one part of the country, the cost does not stay there.
segments.tr: Wenn die Verluste in einem Teil des Landes steigen, bleibt die Kostenlast nicht dort.

segments.src: Insurers price on the basis of their overall results, and the companies that cover your home often operate in dozens of states.
segments.tr: Versicherer kalkulieren auf der Grundlage ihrer Gesamtergebnisse, und die Unternehmen, die Ihr Haus absichern, sind oft in Dutzenden von Bundesstaaten tätig.

segments.src: A bad year in one region can lead to rate filings in many others.
segments.tr: Ein schlechtes Jahr in einer Region kann zu Tarifanträgen in vielen anderen führen.

segments.src: Several forces are working at once.
segments.tr: Mehrere Kräfte wirken gleichzeitig.

segments.src: ### 1. The cost of rebuilding has gone up
segments.tr: ### 1. Die Wiederaufbaukosten sind gestiegen

segments.src: Homeowners insurance is designed to pay to repair or rebuild a home.
segments.tr: Die Wohngebäudeversicherung ist so konzipiert, dass sie für die Reparatur oder den Wiederaufbau eines Hauses aufkommt.

segments.src: Over the past several years, the prices of lumber, roofing materials, electrical components, and skilled labor have risen significantly compared with earlier in the decade.
segments.tr: In den letzten Jahren sind die Preise für Holz, Dacheindeckungsmaterialien, elektrische Komponenten und Fachkräfte im Vergleich zum frühem Jahrzehnt deutlich gestiegen.

segments.src: A policy that adequately covered a house a few years ago may now fall short, so insurers adjust coverage limits upward, and premiums rise with them.
segments.tr: Eine Police, die vor einigen Jahren ein Haus angemessen abdeckte, reicht heute möglicherweise nicht mehr aus, weshalb Versicherer die Deckungsgrenzen nach oben anpassen und die Prämien damit steigen.

segments.src: Even a small claim costs more to settle than it used to.
segments.tr: Sogar ein kleiner Schaden kostet mehr in der Abwicklung als früher.

segments.src: Replacing a roof, repairing water damage, or restoring a kitchen takes more money and, in many places, more time because contractors are in short supply.
segments.tr: Das Ersetzen eines Daches, die Reparatur von Wasserschäden oder die Wiederherstellung einer Küche erfordert mehr Geld und an vielen Orten mehr Zeit, da Handwerker Mangelware sind.

segments.src: ### 2. Reinsurance has become more expensive
segments.tr: ### 2. Rückversicherung ist teurer geworden

segments.src: Insurers buy their own insurance, called reinsurance, to protect themselves against very large events.
segments.tr: Versicherer kaufen ihre eigene Versicherung, die Rückversicherung genannt wird, um sich gegen sehr große Ereignisse zu schützen.

segments.src: Reinsurers have repriced that protection after several years of heavy catastrophe losses worldwide.
segments.tr: Rückversicherer haben diesen Schutz nach mehreren Jahren schwerer Katastrophenschäden weltweit neu bepreist.

segments.src: When an insurer pays more for reinsurance, that expense is typically reflected in the rates it asks regulators to approve.
segments.tr: Wenn ein Versicherer mehr für die Rückversicherung zahlt, spiegelt sich diese Ausgabe typischerweise in den Tarifen wider, die er von den Aufsichtsbehörden genehmigen lässt.

segments.src: Homeowners in a state that has never seen a major hurricane can therefore feel the effects of storms elsewhere.
segments.tr: Hausbesitzer in einem Staat, der noch nie einen großen Hurrikan erlebt hat, können daher die Auswirkungen von Stürmen anderswo spüren.

segments.src: ### 3. Severe weather is not just a coastal problem
segments.tr: ### 3. Unwetter sind nicht nur ein Küstenproblem

segments.src: Hurricanes get the headlines, but a large share of insured losses in recent years has come from other perils: hail, tornadoes, straight-line winds, wildfire, and winter storms.
segments.tr: Hurrikane machen Schlagzeilen, aber ein großer Teil der versicherten Schäden der letzten Jahre stammte aus anderen Gefahren: Hagel, Tornados, geradlinigen Winden, Waldbränden und Winterstürmen.

segments.src: Many of these events strike the middle of the country and the interior West.
segments.tr: Viele dieser Ereignisse treffen den mittleren Teil des Landes und den inneren Westen.

segments.src: Hail in particular can lead to a wave of roof claims across a metro area in a single afternoon.
segments.tr: Insbesondere Hagel kann an einem einzigen Nachmittag zu einer Welle von Dachschäden in einer Metropolregion führen.

segments.src: As these so-called secondary perils have become a bigger part of insurers' loss totals, rate increases have spread to regions that once considered themselves low-risk.
segments.tr: Da diese sogenannten Sekundärgefahren zu einem größeren Teil der Schadenssummen der Versicherer geworden sind, haben sich die Prämienerhöhungen auf Regionen ausgeweitet, die sich einst als risikoarm betrachteten.

segments.src: ### 4. Inflation and legal costs add pressure
segments.tr: ### 4. Inflation und Anwaltskosten erhöhen den Druck

segments.src: General price increases affect every part of a claim, from materials to adjusters to vehicle and equipment costs.
segments.tr: Allgemeine Preissteigerungen betreffen jeden Teil eines Schadens, von Materialien über Gutachter bis hin zu Fahrzeug- und Ausrüstungskosten.

segments.src: In some states, litigation around claims has also added to insurers' expenses.
segments.tr: In einigen Bundesstaaten hat auch die Prozessführung im Zusammenhang mit Schadensfällen die Ausgaben der Versicherer erhöht.

segments.src: Where legal costs are high, insurers say they must build that into pricing.
segments.tr: Dort, wo die Rechtskosten hoch sind, sagen Versicherer, dass sie dies in die Preisgestaltung einbeziehen müssen.

segments.src: Consumer advocates, for their part, note that disputes often arise when claims are delayed or underpaid.
segments.tr: Verbraucherschützer merken ihrerseits an, dass Streitigkeiten oft entstehen, wenn Ansprüche verzögert oder unzureichend bezahlt werden.

segments.src: Both sides agree on one point: costs are rising.
segments.tr: Beide Seiten sind sich in einem Punkt einig: Die Kosten steigen.

segments.src: ## When Insurers Pull Back
segments.tr: ## Wenn Versicherer sich zurückziehen

segments.src: For some homeowners the problem is not only price but availability.
segments.tr: Für einige Hausbesitzer ist das Problem nicht nur der Preis, sondern auch die Verfügbarkeit.

segments.src: A number of insurers have stopped writing new policies in certain states, restricted new business in high-risk areas, or declined to renew existing policies.
segments.tr: Eine Reihe von Versicherern hat aufgehört, neue Policen in bestimmten Bundesstaaten zu schreiben, das Neugeschäft in Hochrisikogebieten eingeschränkt oder die Erneuerung bestehender Policen abgelehnt.

segments.src: Reasons include repeated losses, difficulty getting rate increases approved quickly, and concerns about the age or condition of roofs.
segments.tr: Gründe sind wiederholte Verluste, Schwierigkeiten bei der schnellen Genehmigung von Tariferhöhungen und Bedenken hinsichtlich des Alters oder Zustands von Dächern.

segments.src: When private coverage shrinks, more people turn to state-backed insurers of last resort, often called FAIR Plans or similar programs.
segments.tr: Wenn die private Absicherung schrumpft, wenden sich mehr Menschen staatlich unterstützten Rückversicherungen als letztem Ausweg zu, oft FAIR Plans oder ähnliche Programme genannt.

segments.src: These plans generally offer more limited coverage and can cost more.
segments.tr: Diese Pläne bieten im Allgemeinen eine begrenztere Deckung und können teurer sein.

segments.src: Their growth is itself a warning sign, because a large pool of high-risk policies concentrated in one program can strain the system.
segments.tr: Ihr Wachstum ist selbst ein Warnsignal, da ein großer Pool von Hochrisikopolices, die in einem Programm konzentriert sind, das System belasten kann.

segments.src: Mortgage lenders require coverage, so a lapse is not an option for most owners.
segments.tr: Hypothekengeber verlangen eine Absicherung, daher ist ein Ausfall für die meisten Eigentümer keine Option.

segments.src: That gives homeowners little room to walk away from a high quote, which is part of why the issue feels so pressing.
segments.tr: Das lässt Hausbesitzern wenig Spielraum, ein hohes Angebot abzulehnen, was ein Grund dafür ist, warum das Problem sich so drängend anfühlt.

segments.src: ## What Homeowners Can Do
segments.tr: ## Was Hausbesitzer tun können

segments.src: There is no way to avoid market-wide trends, but there are practical steps that may help limit the damage.
segments.tr: Es gibt keine Möglichkeit, marktweite Trends zu vermeiden, aber es gibt praktische Schritte, die helfen können, den Schaden zu begrenzen.

segments.src: - **Shop around every year.** Quotes for the same house can differ widely between companies. An independent agent can compare several carriers at once.
segments.tr: - **Suchen Sie jedes Jahr nach Alternativen.** Angebote für dasselbe Haus können zwischen Unternehmen stark variieren. Ein unabhängiger Makler kann mehrere Anbieter auf einmal vergleichen.

segments.src: - **Review your coverage, not just the price.** Make sure your dwelling limit reflects current rebuilding costs. Cutting coverage too far to save money can leave a gap after a loss.
segments.tr: - **Überprüfen Sie Ihre Absicherung, nicht nur den Preis.** Stellen Sie sicher, dass Ihre Gebäudegrenze die aktuellen Wiederaufbaukosten widerspiegelt. Die Absicherung zu stark zu kürzen, um Geld zu sparen, kann nach einem Verlust eine Lücke hinterlassen.

segments.src: - **Raise your deductible carefully.** A higher deductible usually lowers the premium, but only choose an amount you could pay from savings. Note that many policies now carry a separate, higher deductible for wind or hail.
segments.tr: - **Erhöhen Sie Ihre Selbstbeteiligung sorgfältig.** Eine höhere Selbstbeteiligung senkt in der Regel die Prämie, wählen Sie jedoch nur einen Betrag, den Sie aus Ersparnissen bezahlen könnten. Beachten Sie, dass viele Policen jetzt eine separate, höhere Selbstbeteiligung für Wind oder Hagel vorsehen.

segments.src: - **Invest in your roof.** Newer or impact-resistant roofing, reinforced garage doors, and properly maintained gutters can reduce risk. Ask your insurer which improvements earn discounts.
segments.tr: - **Investieren Sie in Ihr Dach.** Neuere oder hagelsichere Dächer, verstärkte Garagentore und ordnungsgemäß gewartete Regenrinnen können das Risiko verringern. Fragen Sie Ihren Versicherer, welche Verbesserungen Rabatte bringen.

segments.src: - **Add protective devices.** Water leak sensors, automatic shutoff valves, monitored alarms, and smoke detectors may qualify for credits.
segments.tr: - **Fügen Sie Schutzvorrichtungen hinzu.** Wasseraustrittssensoren, automatische Absperrventile, überwachte Alarmanlagen und Rauchmelder können für Gutschriften qualifizieren.

segments.src: - **Bundle thoughtfully.** Combining home and auto coverage often brings a discount, but compare the bundled price against separate policies.
segments.tr: - **Bündeln Sie durchdacht.** Die Kombination von Heim- und Autoversicherung bringt oft einen Rabatt, aber vergleichen Sie den gebündelten Preis mit separaten Policen.

segments.src: - **Keep your records clean.** Document your home with photos and a home inventory. It speeds claims and helps ensure you are paid fairly.
segments.tr: - **Halten Sie Ihre Unterlagen sauber.** Dokumentieren Sie Ihr Zuhause mit Fotos und einer Hausinventur. Dies beschleunigt Schadensfälle und stellt sicher, dass Sie fair bezahlt werden.

segments.src: - **Ask about your options if you are non-renewed.** Contact your state insurance department, which can explain local choices and consumer protections.
segments.tr: - **Fragen Sie nach Ihren Optionen, wenn Ihre Police nicht verlängert wird.** Wenden Sie sich an Ihre staatliche Versicherungsabteilung, die lokale Auswahlmöglichkeiten und Verbraucherschutzbestimmungen erklären kann.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## Das größere Bild

segments.src: Policymakers are debating how to respond.
segments.tr: Politische Entscheidungsträger diskutieren darüber, wie zu reagieren ist.

segments.src: Proposals include strengthening building codes, funding programs that help owners harden their homes, reforming how states regulate rates, and improving the financial stability of state insurance pools.
segments.tr: Vorschläge umfassen die Stärkung von Bauvorschriften, die Finanzierung von Programmen, die Eigentümern helfen, ihre Häuser abzusichern, die Reform der Regulierung von Tarifen durch die Staaten und die Verbesserung der finanziellen Stabilität von staatlichen Versicherungspools.

segments.src: Each option involves trade-offs between affordability, insurer solvency, and consumer protection, and no single fix is expected to bring premiums back to earlier levels quickly.
segments.tr: Jede Option beinhaltet Kompromisse zwischen Erschwinglichkeit, Zahlungsfähigkeit der Versicherer und Verbraucherschutz, und es wird nicht erwartet, dass eine einzelne Lösung die Prämien schnell wieder auf frühere Niveaus bringt.

segments.src: For now, the practical takeaway is that home insurance is increasingly a cost to be managed actively rather than a bill to be paid on autopilot.
segments.tr: Für den Moment ist die praktische Erkenntnis, dass die Hausratversicherung zunehmend eine Kostenstelle ist, die aktiv verwaltet werden muss, anstatt eine Rechnung, die auf Autopilot bezahlt wird.

segments.src: Reviewing your policy each year, understanding what it covers, and reducing your home's risk are the most reliable tools homeowners have, whether they live on the coast or hundreds of miles inland.
segments.tr: Die jährliche Überprüfung Ihrer Police, das Verständnis dessen, was sie abdeckt, und die Reduzierung des Risikos Ihres Hauses sind die zuverlässigsten Werkzeuge, die Hausbesitzer haben, egal ob sie an der Küste oder Hunderte von Meilen im Landesinneren leben.
